Title: Data Engineer
Description:
¿Qué es Hamelyn?

Somos una empresa tecnológica española que está transformando el mercado de segunda mano. Comprar online es fácil, pero ¿qué pasa con vender lo que ya no necesitas? En Hamelyn, hacemos que vender tus cosas usadas sea rápido y sin complicaciones. Y las revendemos dando un servicio profesional.




Empezamos con libros, y ya hemos añadido música, películas y videojuegos. Y próximamente tendremos nuevas categorías. Ambicionamos ser la aplicación a la que todos acuden para vender sin complicaciones y para comprar productos de segunda mano con el mismo nivel de calidad y servicio que al comprar productos nuevos.




Hoy, Hamelyn atiende a miles de vendedores y compradores diariamente, procesando cientos de miles de productos al mes y enviando pedidos de todas nuestras categorías desde nuestro centro logístico de Madrid a todo el mundo.

Si quieres saber más sobre la historia de Hamelyn, aquí tienes la entrevista de Itnig a nuestros fundadores: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MGkTWW2rVAc&t=10s




Ahora estamos creciendo rápidamente y construyendo una infraestructura de datos a la altura del negocio. Necesitamos un Data Analytics Engineer que trabaje mano a mano con el Data Lead.




🚀¿Listo para construir el futuro con Hamelyn?🚀

Buscamos un experto en datos, perfeccionista con la calidad y la fiabilidad de la información, con experiencia tanto en infraestructura como en análisis de datos. Reportarás al Data Lead.




🎯 Misión:

Mejorar y escalar los sistemas de datos de Hamelyn y analizarlos para impulsar decisiones de negocio y mejoras en producto y tecnología.




🔥 En qué trabajarás:

Operamos en múltiples países con más de 30 millones de productos catalogados e integrados con marketplaces como Amazon, eBay y MercadoLibre. Esto es lo que tenemos por delante:

Analizar datos clave del negocio para detectar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades (pricing, catálogo, conversión, supply, operaciones).
Definir y mantener métricas y fuentes de verdad (dashboards, tablas base, documentación) para que el equipo tome decisiones rápido.
Construir y mejorar pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) y modelos de datos listos para análisis (data marts), con foco en fiabilidad y rapidez.
Mantener y mejorar bases de datos, data quality y automatizar procesos de reporting.
Apoyar en la construcción y validación de modelos analíticos o predictivos: preparación de datasets, features, validaciones y medición de impacto.
Colaborar con producto y negocio para traducir preguntas en hipótesis, experimentos y decisiones medibles.




Requisitos clave:

Buen dominio de SQL y Python para análisis, automatizaciones y manejo de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con datos en entornos reales: análisis, modelado, pipelines y mantenimiento de fuentes.
Capacidad para convertir datos en decisiones: plantear hipótesis, medir impacto, comunicar hallazgos y proponer acciones.
Bases sólidas en estadística aplicada (tests, segmentación, cohortes, funnels).
Mentalidad hands-on, autonomía y buena comunicación con stakeholders no técnicos.
Experiencia construyendo y/o usando modelos analíticos o predictivos (forecasting, scoring, clasificación, recomendación).
Experiencia en product analytics / growth analytics (experimentos, atribución, conversión, retención).
Buen criterio para definir métricas (North Star, guardrails) y diseñar reporting útil y accionable.
MongoDB.
Experiencia en cloud (GCP, AWS o Azure): despliegue de pipelines, gestión de servicios gestionados de datos y buenas prácticas de IAM/costes.
Experiencia con algún warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar) y buenas prácticas de versionado/CI.




Qué ofrecemos:

Salario altamente competitivo según experiencia.
Modelo híbrido orientado a productividad.
Servicio de comida y gimnasio.
Presupuesto de formación continua.
Sin burocracia, enfoque a resultados.
Un equipo joven, pragmático y ambicioso centrado en resultados reales y en hacer crecer el negocio.




Si buscas un proyecto ambicioso donde aplicar tus capacidades con resultados visibles, y seguir creciendo en una empresa de rápida expansión, te estamos esperando! 🙌

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:

2+ years of analytical work experience, preferably for a web or mobile company/e-commerce/ Online Gaming industry.
BA/B.Sc. in Statistics / Math / Engineering / Economics or other quantitative field.
Strong SQL with experience in querying large, complex data sets.
Strong Excel skill.
Proven experience leading data driven projects from definition




Desired

Advanced knowledge in statistical tools and models- advantage

Los requisitos son los siguientes:




-3 años de experiencia

- Conocimientos técnicos básicos de desarrollo: Java, Python y Shell-Script

- Experiencia en soluciones de mercado:

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
En Carrefour estamos transformando nuestros sistemas centrales para modernizar nuestra actividad principal, el comercio al por menor.




Si quieres ser parte de una empresa dinámica, dentro de un sector con gran potencial de desarrollo que te ofrecerá oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y personal, nos encantará tener la oportunidad de conocerte.




Buscamos un/una Data Analyst para nuestra dirección de seguros con el objetivo de análizar los datos de la compañía con eje cliente através de la minería de los datos a partir de distintas fuentes y sobre un entorno Big Data y con el objetivo de transformarlos en información accionable para la compañía y proveer a la Compañia de informes y visualizaciones de datos útiles para la toma de decisiones. Discriminar y separar los datos para ofrecer información relevante a sus clientes. Potenciar e impulsar nuevos planteamientos de análisis orientados al cliente con el objetivo de realizar aportaciones de valor a las Unidades de




La posición debe potenciar e impulsar nuevos planteamientos de análisis orientados al cliente con el objetivo de realizar aportaciones de valor a las Unidades de Negocio.




Entre sus funciones principales se encuentran:




-Tener una visión clara de negocio con el fin de ayudar a las unidades de negocio a mejorar su toma de decisiones con respecto al cliente.

- Ofrecer una visualización de los datos que permita su mejor entendimiento por sus clientes.

- Aportar análisis cuantitativos basados en el histórico de datos internos de los clientes para ofrecer previsiones de comportamiento del mismo a Negocio, con el objetivo de ajustar los esfuerzos comerciales a la tendencia del cliente Realizar aportes de valor a las unidades de negocio orientado a la mejora de las decisiones que se adopten.

- Análisis e interpretación de los resultados a partir de distintas técnicas avanzadas (regresiones, algoritmos matemáticos avanzados…) y de herramientas analíticas para detectar las causas raíz de problemas de áreas de negocio .




Nos encantaría conocerte si cuentas con:




-Titulación de Ingeniero Superior, Matemático o Estadístico.

-Experiencia de 2 años en puestos similares.

-Ingles nivel medio-alto.

-Bases Datos SQL y Data Mining.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido

Salario competitivo (fijo + variable)

Descuento del 8% para ti y para 6 personas más en nuestras tiendas

Programas que se preocupan por tu bienestar:

Carrefour Life (actividades y eventos deportivos, descuentos y ventajas exclusivas)

Carrefour Flexible (retribución flexible para seguro médico, guarderías, transporte…)

Formación continua

Desarrollo profesional




Valoraremos todas las candidaturas interesadas y si eres la persona seleccionada para avanzar en el proceso, nos pondremos en contacto contigo para darte más detalles del puesto y conocer tu perfil.




En Carrefour apostamos por un espacio de trabajo idóneo para que cualquier persona con independencia de su género, orientación sexual, identidad y/o expresión de género, creencias, ideologías, origen, capacidades, entre otras, pueda desplegar todo su potencial.

About PRGX

PRGX is the global leader in source-to-pay data analytics and software, and tech-enabled profit recovery services. We provide software and services to maximize revenue recovery and drive margin improvement for our clients. For more information about PRGX, visit www.prgx.com.

Experience with DBT (Data Build Tool) for data transformation, modeling, and workflow automation.
Knowledge of modern data platforms and cloud ecosystems, including GCP and Snowflake, especially for enabling scalable data consumption for clients.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and efficient solutions for audit teams.

Support and develop RPA solutions using Python and Selenium
Contribute to data governance initiatives
Identify opportunities to automate and optimize processes using AI and intelligent automation


Knowledge & Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred)
Knowledge of Trino, SQL, and Python
At least 2\3 years of experience in business analysis, data, or related roles
Strong communication and adaptability skills
Ability to detect, analyze, and solve problems efficiently
Team-oriented mindset - we are team players!
Fluent English is a must
Interest in process improvement, automation, and AI applications
Proactive attitude towards learning and optimizing existing workflows

Title: Data & Automation Data Specialist
Description:
About Us:




HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.




We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.




HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets.




We are looking for a Data and Automation Specialist to join our Customer Experience and Automation Team in Palma de Mallorca. The main purpose of the role is to implement and maintain specific data ecosystems using Snowflake/PostgreSQL and build hybrid agentic-deterministic workflows on low-code platforms to optimize efficiency.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Implement and update data structures on Snowflake following established architectural guidelines, ensuring quality and performance of assigned datasets.
Build and maintain datasets to allow automation of business processes using low-code/no-code platforms like Appian, n8n, Salesforce, and similar tools to integrate reservation systems, CRM, marketing, and customer service platforms.
Develop connections using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate LLMs with external data sources as defined in technical specifications.
Deploy and integrate generative AI models to personalize traveler experiences, automate content creation, manage chatbots, and support predictive analytics for demand and customer behavior.
Collaborate with the Lead and stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional automation workflows and dashboards.
Monitor AI and automation workflows, iterating for improved performance, reliability, and business impact.
Build data queries for visualisations to analyse business processes and monitor change impact.




CANDIDATE PROFILE:

Effective written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with team members and stakeholders.
Strong practical skills in SQL and Python for complex data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
A strong team player mindset with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and foster positive working relationships.
Demonstrated lateral thinking and creativity in solving complex problems and designing innovative automation and AI solutions.
Deep understanding and applied knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar open standards for integrating LLMs with external systems.
Knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and a commitment to ethical AI practices.
Familiarity with major cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and BI/data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing scalable data solutions in Snowflake or PostgreSQL.
Demonstrated experience building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade workflows on low-code/no-code platforms such as Salesforce, Appian, and/or n8n.
Practical experience developing and consuming REST APIs for complex system integrations in a professional environment.
Previous experience working within an Agile or iterative project management methodology is desirable.
Experience in applying AI for personalization and automation is highly desired, preferably within the tourism or hospitality sector.
Familiarity with using BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to create business-facing dashboards.




At HBX Group, we believe diversity fuels innovation and strengthens our mission to make travel a force for good. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities truly make a difference.




You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.




As well as an attractive benefits package you will be able to work:

Within an innovative, engaging and multicultural environment.
Have the opportunity to build strong and lasting business relationships and friendships from around the world.
Have the opportunity in developing your career locally or within one of our beautiful working locations across the globe.

+2 años como Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst avanzado o rol híbrido equivalente.

Title: Data Migration Analyst
Description:
NN Digital Hub is a subsidiary company of NN Group located in Madrid, Spain. We deliver IT services and solutions for the different international Business Units.

Data Migration Analyst

Your Impact as Data Migration Analyst: What are you going to do


Responsible for supporting the end-to-end process of transferring data from legacy to new environments
Create a data mapping, ensuring accuracy, quality, and alignment with business requirements.
Develop and execute test plans to validate the accuracy and completeness of migrated data
Identify and resolve data issues and discrepancies during the migration process, working with other teams.
Monitor the migration process for performance and efficiency, making adjustments to optimize the data transfer.


Key Responsibilities Include


In-depth understanding of insurance industry concepts, products, policy administration processes, claims, investments and accounting.
Perform ETL process to extract data from source systems, transform it according to migration requirements, and load it into the target system.
Develop and implement data cleansing, normalization, and transformation rules to ensure data consistency and quality.

Title: Data Quality Analyst
Description:
About Dwelly

Dwelly is a UK-based, AI-enabled lettings and property management platform growing through a roll-up strategy by acquiring estate agencies and integrating them into a modern technology platform.

As we acquire agencies, we inherit large volumes of operational data from different CRM systems. Every migration introduces differences in data quality, structure, and completeness. Maintaining high-quality production data is critical to ensuring a reliable customer experience.

Position Summary

We're looking for a Data Quality Analyst to own the validation and quality assurance of data migrations into Dwelly.

Your primary responsibility will be reviewing and approving CRM data migrations before they reach production. You'll work closely with backend engineers and migration tooling to ensure imported data is complete, accurate, and internally consistent.

This role combines advanced SQL, data analysis, automated validation, and investigation of real-world data quality issues. You'll design validation queries, identify inconsistencies, investigate unexpected results, and help improve our migration tooling over time.

The ideal candidate has exceptional attention to detail, enjoys investigating data problems, and is comfortable making release decisions based on evidence.

Key Responsibilities


Data Migration Validation Review and approve CRM migration datasets before production deployment by validating completeness, consistency, and overall data quality.
Production Data Quality Review production data updates and validate SQL scripts before execution to ensure large-scale changes are safe and correct.
Data Integrity Verification Develop automated validation queries that detect missing records, duplicate entities, broken relationships, and other integrity issues across migrated datasets.
Migration Reconciliation Compare source CRM exports with Dwelly data to verify successful migration and investigate discrepancies.
Data Investigation Analyse unexpected migration results, identify root causes of inconsistencies, and work with engineers to resolve complex data issues.
Continuous Quality Improvement Identify recurring migration issues and help improve migration processes, validation tooling, and overall data quality standards.


Qualifications And Preferred Background


Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and update scripts
Experience validating production data or large database migrations
Strong understanding of relational databases and data integrity principles
Experience investigating inconsistencies across large datasets
Comfortable comparing data from multiple systems and identifying discrepancies
Ability to design automated validation checks instead of relying on manual inspection
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong ownership mindset with the confidence to approve or reject production data changes
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to work independently in ambiguous situations
Ability to effectively use modern AI development tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to improve productivity, investigate data issues, generate SQL, automate repetitive tasks, and accelerate analysis while maintaining high standards of accuracy and review.


Technical Environment


PostgreSQL
MySQL
DuckDB (testing and validation)
Git
SQLMesh or dbt
Dolt or similar version-controlled database technologies
CSV-based CRM migrations


Nice to Have


Python for automation and data analysis
Experience building automated data quality frameworks
Knowledge of ETL or ELT pipelines
Experience working with CRM migrations or property management systems
Familiarity with data observability and reconciliation tooling


What Success Looks Like


Production migrations are approved with confidence and minimal manual effort.
Automated validation catches the vast majority of migration issues before deployment.
Data integrity issues are identified early and resolved quickly.
Migration quality improves continuously through better validation and investigation.
Engineers trust the migration approval process because it is evidence-driven, repeatable, and reliable.


Compensation & Benefits:


Fully remote role.
Competitive compensation based on experience and impact.
Opportunity to work on high-leverage automation systems at the intersection of backend engineering, applied ML, data and real operational workflows.
Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.


What is it like being a Dwell-er?

Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.

What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is about solving one of the world’s most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world: residential rentals.

More than 30% of households live in rental homes — over 5 million in the UK and more than 100 million across the EU and US. Our mission is to improve that experience through technology, automation and operational excellence.

This is about disrupting one of the largest and most antiquated industries in the world with one of the strongest operational and technical teams in the UK and Europe.

We work hard, and we aim for extremely ambitious results. We want people to be proud of what they’ve built and to one day look back and say: “Hell yeah, that was me that did it.”

Our Principles


Customer obsession rather than competitive focus
Passion for invention
Operational excellence
Long-term thinking


By applying for this position, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data for recruitment purposes for up to 365 days, in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable data protection laws.

Description:
En Kids&Us diseñamos experiencias que conectan con la emoción de aprender inglés.

Combinamos pedagogía, tecnología y datos para mejorar continuamente la experiencia de aprendizaje de miles de niños/as y familias en todo el mundo. A través del dato, impulsamos decisiones más inteligentes y construimos las bases que nos permiten seguir creciendo con impacto.

En este contexto de evolución, buscamos un/a Data Analyst que analice y explote los datos para generar insights, reportings y cuadros de mando que apoyen la toma de decisiones y la evolución del negocio.

¿Por qué te encantará formar parte de Kids&Us?


Un producto con propósito real.
Espacio para construir y dejar huella.
Un equipo cercano, motivado y multidisciplinar que combina aprendizaje, diseño y tecnología. Nos gusta compartir logros, aprender y celebrar el camino: organizamos team buildings, town halls, eventos especiales y… ¡mucho más! 😊
Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (2 días en HQ y 3 de teletrabajo).
Horario flexible de lunes a jueves, y jornada intensiva los viernes y durante el verano.
Día libre en tu cumpleaños, descuentos para tu familia y más beneficios pensados para cuidarte y crecer profesionalmente.


Tu rol


Analizar datos y generar insights accionables para las distintas áreas de negocio (producto, operaciones, corporate).
Traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas, definiendo KPIs y métricas que permitan medir el rendimiento.
Diseñar y mantener dashboards e informes, asegurando una visualización clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Dar soporte a equipos de negocio en sus necesidades de reporting y análisis, facilitando el acceso y uso del dato.
Velar por la calidad y consistencia de los datos utilizados en los análisis y cuadros de mando.
Colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de Data en la validación de modelos de datos y en la evolución del ecosistema de analytics.
Participar en la evolución del servicio de analytics y en futuras iniciativas de advanced analytics o data science.


Así brillarás en este puesto


Grado en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería, ADE o similar, y valorable máster o especialización en Data Analytics o Business Intelligence.
Entre 2 y 4 años de experiencia en roles de Data Analyst o similares, trabajando en análisis de datos y reporting.
Experiencia sólida en análisis de datos, SQL y herramientas de BI (power BI, Tableau, etc.) y de product analytics (Amplitude o similares).
Persona analítica, con capacidad de síntesis, orientación a negocio y buenas habilidades de comunicación.
Nivel de inglés avanzado.


Ready to inspire?

Si te motiva trabajar con datos, entender el negocio y generar impacto real a través del análisis y los insights, este es tu reto. ¡Queremos conocerte!

En este contexto de evolución, buscamos un/a Data Analyst que analice y explote los datos para generar insights, reportings y cuadros de mando que apoyen la toma de decisiones y la evolución del negocio.

¿Por qué te encantará formar parte de Kids&Us?

  • Espacio para construir y dejar huella.

  • Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (2 días en HQ y 3 de teletrabajo).

Tu rol

  • Colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de Data en la validación de modelos de datos y en la evolución del ecosistema de analytics.

Description:
YoBrands, part of The Rank Group, is a leading online gaming operator in the Spanish & Portuguese markets with an expanding online and offline portfolio focused on bingo, casino and sports betting with 4 leading brands: Enracha, YoCasino, YoBingo and YoSports

Our goals are to provide entertainment and community to our customers with our websites and apps so that they can access our products from their mobile phones, tablets while communicating with one another.

We offer our own bingo and slots software and more than 2000 games from the best game providers. We also offer live shows such as El Show De YoBingo and YoSports TV!

With offices based in Barcelona, Ceuta & Malta we always strive to bring joy and security to our customers. Additionally, we will be launching soon in other regulated markets!

Job Purpose

Provide insightful, actionable analyses through dashboards, and reports, to impact our revenue, productivity, acquisition, attrition, operational efficiencies, cross-sell strategies, customer behavior, and segmentation.

This role comes with a high rate of exposure to various parts of the business due to regular senior stakeholder engagement.

Main Accountabilities And Responsibilities


Extract, transform and load data from different data sources.
Work with existing and new technologies to shape the development of analytical insight delivery.
Translates customer, transactional and behavioral data into key insights and business deliverables.
Presents findings to key stakeholders, and inputs to negotiations on strategies to drive performance across the business.
Collaborating with team members and stakeholders to build data products that enable others to work with reporting effectively and inform decision-making that solve business problems with data.
Engage with Key stakeholders to develop key metrics to measure business performance.


Knowledge, Expertise And Qualifications


Demonstrated ability to build solutions and user-friendly dashboards and reports using BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
Experience working with ETL tools (Databricks is a plus).
Experience manipulating data stored in relational databases using SQL (proficiency SQL level required).
Familiar with Agile methodology (JIRA).
Experience engaging with key stakeholders.
Ability to work as part of a team delivering solutions that can be deployed into production.
Ability to take initiative and work independently to manage and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Excellent experience working in a data driven environment.
Ability to gather requirements and map business needs to KPI dashboards.
Creative, innovative thinker with outstanding problem-solving skills.
Meticulous and thorough, with a healthy respect for quality & standards.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to communicate results to non-technical audiences.
Essential: very good knowledge of English at all levels and native-level Spanish.
Degree qualified.


Personal Qualities


Demonstrate sense of passion and pride about own work.
Positive attitude and adapts well to change.
Foster curiosity which results in new lines of thinking, original insight, and breakthrough ideas for the business.
Encourage and challenge others to investigate and explore alternative solutions and ideas.
Ability to translate and clearly formulate technical issues and solutions to the issues.
Excellent problem solving and analysis skills.
Excellent communication skills- written and verbal.
Excellent presentational skills.
Intervenes if warning signs of problems occur within own area of responsibility.
Forward thinking. Proactive rather than Reactive.
Positive and constructive minded.
Takes responsibility for continuous self –learning.
Attention to detail.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

We are looking for an exceptional Data Analyst to join the Coches.Net, Motos.Net and Milanuncios.com team. You will work as a member of multidisciplinary team, collaborating closely with Product owners, cluster teams, data engineers and management team stake-holders (Marketing, Sales, Product, BizDev and other Operations teams).

Your main mission is to define and execute analyses of several business context to identify trends, opportunities and problems to improve the offering and services we offer.

Job Requirements


3+ years of experience in eCommerce, an online company.
Advanced knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Advanced knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis (e.g. pandas, numpy, matplotlib), and advanced analytics (e.g. scikit-learn)
Advanced user of at least one visualisation tool such as Tableau and/or QlikSense.
Analytical skills: know how to interpret data, to extract relevant insights and be able to translate business questions into analytical needs Nice-to-have
Experience working with sales, operations, and strategy teams.
Good knowledge of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g. clustering, classification, regressions)


Nice To Have


Experience working with sales, operations, and strategy teams.
Good knowledge of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g. clustering, classification, regressions)
Some experience with big data technology (e.g. databricks, datalakes)
Some knowledge of data engineering tools (e.g. Airflow, DBT)


Job Responsibilities


Identify, analyse and interpret KPIs and Health Metrics related to our users and customers, creating dashboard and visualisation to monitor them.
Identifying trends, risks and opportunities to provide insights that can make recommendations on how to improve the different initiatives of the vertical.
Create powerful Insights using Advanced analytics to improve the knowledge of our users and customers.
Actively participate in the discovery, and development of advanced analytical models (such as clustering, and predictive models), into their implementation in business use cases, such as customer segmentation, and propensity models for upselling, downselling, and churn prediction.

Title: REVENUE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS ANALYST
Description:
LEVEL is a long-haul airline based in Barcelona and part of the IAG group. The company is customer-centric and places a strong emphasis on values such as commitment, an open attitude, a constant drive for improvement, and making travel easy for their customers. With a focus on providing an exceptional customer experience, LEVEL is committed to delivering top-notch service and exceeding the expectations of their passengers

Job Purpose

The RM Systems Specialist supports the Revenue Management team in the day-to-day calibration of the Revenue Management System (RMS), the automation of manual processes, and the development of the KPI framework. This role blends strong data analytics skills with growing expertise in RM systems, enabling the Pricing and Inventory teams to work faster, smarter, and with better data.

The RM Systems Specialist reports to the RM Systems, Processes & KPIs Manager

Main Responsibilities - Tasks2. Process Excellence & Business Automation3. KPI Framework & Performance AuditingEducation


RMS Ownership & Technical Strategy
System Configuration & Calibration: Support the administration and fine-tuning of the Revenue Management Systems (AirRM & PROS), assisting with demand forecasting models, influence factors, and optimizer settings.
Business Rule Management: Support the implementation and validation of RM business rules, ensuring system configurations align with commercial and operational objectives.
Data Integration & Quality Assurance: Validate data flows between the PSS, RMS, and external data sources (e.g., Infare), ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability for Revenue Management processes.
Automation Projects: Design and build automation scripts and tools (SQL, Python, RPA) to eliminate manual, repetitive tasks and free up analyst time for higher-value work.
System Enhancements & Testing: Coordinate and execute functional testing for RM system enhancements, configuration changes, and new releases, ensuring solutions meet business requirements before deployment.
Knowledge Management & Best Practices: Develop and maintain the RM knowledge base, documenting system processes and best practices to ensure consistency and facilitate knowledge sharing across the team.
Dashboard Development: Build and maintain the RM “Health Check” dashboard in Power BI, tracking metrics such as Forecast Accuracy (MAPE), Yield Opportunity Loss, and Spill/Spoilage.
Override Analysis: Support “Post-Mortem” audits on analyst overrides to help measure their value-add versus the system’s baseline.
Data Deep-Dives: Analyze no-show trends, cancellation patterns, and denied boarding data to identify revenue opportunities/leakage points.


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or similar).

Experience

Prior experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or in a similar quantitative role is required; prior experience in Revenue Management, Pricing, or the airline/travel industry is a plus, but not a must

Competencies


System Exposure: Familiarity with RM systems (AirRM, PROS, or similar) and core RM concepts (e.g., EMSRb, Dynamic Pricing) is a plus.


Technical Stack:


SQL: Solid working knowledge (BigQuery, Snowflake, or SQL Server) for data extraction and analysis.
Data Viz: Experience with Power BI or Tableau to build dashboards and automated reports.
Coding: Proficiency in Python or R for automation and predictive modeling is highly valued.
Analytical Mindset: Comfortable investigating why numbers move and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Communication: Able to work closely with both technical teams and commercial stakeholders
Mindset: Analytical, curious, and driven to continuously learn, with a strong interest in developing expertise in RM and supporting data-driven decisions.


Languages


Fluent in English and Spanish


Other

Key Performance Indicators (The "Owner" of these metrics)Location


Forecast Accuracy: Contributing to reducing the delta between predicted and actual demand.
Automation Impact: Number and impact of manual processes automated and analyst hours saved.
Dashboard Reliability: Accuracy and timeliness of KPI dashboards and reports delivered.
Data Integrity: Minimizing discrepancies between PSS, RMS, and BI reporting.


Viladecans, Barcelona

Title: Data Analyst II Rider Experience
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR WORK-LIFE OPPORTUNITY:

Join our team and become an integral part of Glovo's Global Logistics! We provide a dynamic and challenging environment filled with numerous opportunities for growth and development.

In this role, you will be responsible for redesigning, testing, and implementing the payment structures that motivate and reward our riders worldwide. By blending deep data analysis and data modeling with creative problem-solving, your work will ensure our logistics network is efficient, scalable, and fair for our riders. The KPIs you will influence are crucial to operations, as every decision made will directly affect the whole operational investment (biggest company cost).

Be a Part Of a Team Where You Will


Explore and find the most optimal logistics payment structure in order to maximize global riders engagement.
Strategically redesign our courier payment framework to improve key operational metrics, designing models that reward factors like vehicle used, distance, weight, and peak-hour availability.
Dive deep into massive datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Your insights will be the foundation for optimizing our entire operational investment.
Own the experimentation process to validate your ideas. You will design, run, and analyze experiments (A/B testing, switchback tests) to precisely measure the impact of payment structure changes before a global rollout.
Continuously monitor the performance of your strategies. You will track KPIs, assess the effectiveness of your changes, and make data-driven adjustments as needed.
Understand and address local and regional needs by stepping into the shoes of the riders and truly understanding their perspective.


Qualifications

YOU HAVE


Degree in Engineering, Maths or another STEM field.
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role where you translated insights into tangible business actions and measured their impact.
Strong technical proficiency
Advanced SQL for complex querying and data extraction.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and data orchestration.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.
Nice to have experience with experimentation. Designing and/or analyzing A/B tests or other statistical testing methodologies to measure impact.
Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.
You can clearly and concisely explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English is a must.
You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Additional Information

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.


At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Fraud Data Analyst, you'll be the person who secures the future of digital payments by architecting sophisticated real-time defense strategies.

Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimizing the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimize the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalize machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyze security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Expect challenges, collaboration, and the freedom to bring your ideas to life in a fast-moving and supportive environment. Things change quickly here, so be ready to adapt, take initiative, and shape your role as we grow.

Who We're Looking For

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you?


Experience – You have between 3 and 7 years of professional experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.


CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It's a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we're committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That's why we created CareAbout:


❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops)
💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you're moving countries)
⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply)
🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours)
👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness)
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.


Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Title: Junior Data Analyst & AI Automation Specialist
Description:
En Rubió llevamos más de 55 años trabajando para que todas las personas tengan acceso a nuestros medicamentos, independientemente de la prevalencia de su patología, contribuyendo así a mejorar su calidad de vida.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst & Automation Specialist para Nutribrain, una compañía especializada en la fabricación y comercialización de suplementos alimenticios naturales, orientados al bienestar mental y físico, la nutrición y la mejora de la calidad de vida, con una fuerte apuesta por la innovación, la investigación y la calidad en el ámbito de la salud.




La posición estará ubicada en Barcelona y se integrará en un equipo pequeño y ágil, donde los datos tienen un papel clave en la toma de decisiones. La persona seleccionada trabajará directamente con el CEO, con autonomía y margen para proponer y desarrollar soluciones.




¿Cuál será tu rol?




La persona seleccionada tendrá un rol dinámico y transversal, combinando análisis de datos, desarrollo de herramientas y automatización de procesos.




Será responsable de transformar datos en información útil para el negocio y de desarrollar soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y automatizar procesos, trabajando con datos de ventas, previsiones, stock y diferentes plataformas y marketplaces.




Además del análisis técnico, la persona será capaz de interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio, entendiendo el impacto de variables como ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, stock, rotación de producto y previsiones, para aportar recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.




Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a diferentes áreas del negocio, participando en el desarrollo de soluciones y herramientas propias.




Funciones principales




Análisis de datos y automatización

Analizar datos de negocio, incluyendo ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales, identificando tendencias, estacionalidades e inconsistencias.
Desarrollar dashboards y herramientas de visualización que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y desarrollar automatizaciones e integraciones entre plataformas, APIs y bases de datos.
Crear flujos de datos automatizados y herramientas propias para obtener información de fuentes sin API oficial, mediante web scraping y automatización de navegadores.
Desarrollar aplicaciones y soluciones internas adaptadas a las necesidades del negocio.
Interpretar indicadores de negocio relacionados con ventas, rentabilidad, stock y catálogo de producto, identificando oportunidades de mejora y apoyando la toma de decisiones desde una perspectiva financiera y comercial.




IA y desarrollo de nuevas soluciones

Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a procesos y necesidades reales del negocio.
Integrar modelos de lenguaje y herramientas de IA en flujos de trabajo y automatizaciones.
Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones de IA audiovisual para generación de vídeo, voz e imagen.
Identificar nuevas oportunidades de automatización y proponer soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y aportar valor al negocio.




¿Qué requisitos buscamos?




Formación y experiencia: 2-4 años de experiencia en análisis de datos aplicado a negocio, con capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos y entornos dinámicos.
Análisis de datos: sólida capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico, con experiencia en análisis de ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales.
Programación y datos: buen dominio de SQL y Python (pandas), experiencia con datasets reales, Git/GitHub y APIs REST.
Automatización: experiencia con web scraping, automatización de navegadores y herramientas de integración y automatización de procesos.
Herramientas y tecnología: nivel avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y, valorable, experiencia con herramientas de BI, bases de datos, n8n, Make, Zapier o tecnologías similares.
IA y nuevas tecnologías: Dominio de asistentes de programación y desarrollo basados en IA, como Codex, Claude Code, Cursor o herramientas similares, utilizándolos de forma habitual para acelerar el desarrollo y la automatización, curiosidad por mantenerse al día de la evolución de los modelos de IA, nuevas capacidades y herramientas emergentes, evaluando su aplicación práctica en el entorno empresarial.
Perfil personal: persona resolutiva, autónoma, organizada y con capacidad para gestionar proyectos propios y encontrar soluciones ante nuevos retos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación estable.
Presencial de lunes, miércoles y jueves en oficinas de Barcelona.
Martes y viernes con posibilidad de teletrabajo.
Viernes con jornada intensiva.
Incorporación a un equipo en crecimiento con oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional.




Si crees que encajas con el perfil y quieres formar parte de un equipo comprometido con la innovación y la excelencia, ¡te estamos buscando!




Si quieres saber más sobre nosotros, visita nuestra web:




www.laboratoriosrubio.com

https://www.nutribrain.eu/

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title

Associate Data Analyst

Summary

We're looking for a Data Governance Analyst to help ensure the quality, accuracy, and consistency of data across the Amadeus Hospitality Business Intelligence ecosystem. In this role, you'll work closely with business and technical teams to investigate data issues, maintain critical master data, support data governance initiatives, and drive continuous improvements that enhance the reliability of our products and services.

Key Responsibilities


Ensure high standards of data quality across Hospitality BI products and systems.
Manage master data, including property updates, mappings, rebrands, and business identifiers.
Investigate, analyze, and resolve data quality issues in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
Validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with governance standards.
Use SQL and other analytical tools to research, troubleshoot, and monitor data.
Contribute to data governance initiatives, process improvements, and cross-functional projects that strengthen data management practices.


About The Ideal Candidate


Experience in the hospitality industry with a solid understanding of hospitality operations, terminology, and data.
Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS), reservations data, or other hospitality technology platforms.
Background in Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.
Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting; knowledge of BI and ETL processes is an advantage.
Understanding of databases, data warehousing, or data architecture concepts is a plus.
Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.
Self-motivated, organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative setting.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in hospitality, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.


What We Can Offer You


🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose


Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Title: Data Analyst - People & Product
Description:
Hi! 👋

At Factorial we're on the lookout for a Data Analyst to raise the bar on how we turn data into decisions across the business 🚀.

The Role ✨

At Factorial, data sits at the heart of every decision we make — and we're looking for a Data Analyst to make it count where it matters most: our people.

This is a hybrid role that combines two profiles — the responsibilities of an Analytics Engineer and those of a Data Analyst. As an Analytics Engineer, you model and structure data in the gold layer with DBT, turning raw tables into reliable, documented models a whole business area can trust. As a Data Analyst, you build advanced analysis on top of them, own the metrics they expose, and deliver the reporting the business runs on — carrying out dashboards and ad-hoc deep-dives that turn open questions into decisions, hand in hand with Business.

You'll focus primarily on our People area — our biggest opportunity — bringing a data-driven approach to how we understand, hire, and grow our teams, and shaping high-stakes decisions across talent acquisition, headcount planning, engagement, and performance. You'll also partner with Product, helping define how we iterate the product and turning data into real impact on pricing, packaging, and usage.

Factorial is a fast-paced scale-up in constant evolution — some areas are still building their data foundations while others are already driven by the power of data . You won't inherit a finished playbook; you'll write it, raising the analytical bar as the company grows. If you're driven by curiosity, energized by ambiguity, and want ownership of both the data model and the decisions it drives, this one's for you

What You'll Be Doing


Own the data models: Design, build, and maintain the gold-layer models (DBT) that become the single source of truth for your business area — with the tests and documentation that keep them trusted and reused across teams.
Own metrics and governance: Define and document your area's KPIs, resolve conflicting definitions across teams, and maintain a single source of truth others are expected to use.
Treat dashboards as a product: Build reporting in Power BI with clear ownership, and keep iterating on it based on how it's actually used.
Go beyond dashboards: Run the advanced analysis that answers the "why" — cohort and retention analyses, impact modeling, and scenario / forecasting — and turn findings into concrete product, pricing, or lifecycle recommendations.
Enable decision-making: Partner with Business and Product teams to turn ambiguous questions into the right analysis, and run the work that determines whether a decision actually moved the needle.
Foster business–data collaboration: Embed with your stakeholders, build a shared language around metrics, and strengthen how the business and the Data team work together — so data becomes a habit, not an afterthought.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics Engineers to keep data integrity high, prepare the layer models consume, and translate model outputs into metrics the business understands.
Master data storytelling: Turn analysis into clear narratives that align stakeholders and inspire action — so the work actually changes what people do.


What We're Looking For

You're likely a great fit if you:


Have 3+ years in Analytics Engineering, BI, or Data Analyst roles — ideally in a fast-paced, scaling tech environment.
Write fluent, independent SQL — you can model and debug complex queries on your own, without waiting on review.
Are comfortable with Python for analysis and lightweight data workflows.
Know your way around DBT and a layered / medallion modeling approach (bronze / silver / gold).
Have shipped a BI tool in production, Power BI ideally (or an equivalent like Looker / Tableau).
Have solid advanced-analytics fundamentals: cohort and retention analysis, segmentation, funnel and driver analysis, and experimentation (A/B) backed by a solid statistics background.
Use version control (Git / GitHub) as part of your normal workflow.
Are business-minded and communicate with impact — you understand what stakeholders really need (not just what they ask for), reframe the question, and translate complex data into clear, actionable insight that drives decisions.
Are autonomous, proactive, and detail-oriented — you see ambiguity as an opportunity, not a blocker.
Treat the metrics and models you build as products, not one-off deliverables.
Have English working proficiency.


Bonus Points if You:


Understand subscription or product-based (SaaS) economics and can connect data work to revenue, growth, and retention outcomes.
Have owned a metrics framework that became the reference.
Have partnered closely with Data Science to bring models into production and translate their output into business decisions.
Have helped build or scale an analytics function — tooling, modeling and documentation standards, processes, and KPI frameworks — leaving it more mature than you found it.
Have delivered visible impact in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment, bringing structure to ambiguity and moving decisions forward.
Have a quantitative background (degree or equivalent practical depth) you apply to real business problems.


If you're ready to take on this challenge at Factorial, apply now! We can't wait to see what you'll bring to our team. 🌟

Compensation 💰

The salary range for this position is [42800 - 53500 ]€ total compensation + ESOP plan. We won't consider how many years of experience you have but your knowledge and skills.

We care about people, and we also offer employee benefits.

About Factorial 🚀

At Factorial, we’re building the leading AI Business Management Software for companies of all sizes. Our platform centralizes key workflows across HR, Finance, Talent, Operations, and IT, freeing teams from manual processes so they can focus on what really matters: leading, growing, and taking care of their people.With over 1,500 employees across Europe, Asia, Africa, and America. We are one of Europe’s fastest-growing SaaS companies, proudly headquartered in Barcelona. If you're excited to shape the future of business management technology, we’d love to meet you.

We believe in diverse talent: we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of diverse experiences and identities to apply.

We believe in inclusion: we are committed to equal opportunities and actively promote workplace inclusion of people with disabilities. If you would like to learn more about our inclusive recruitment processes, you are welcome to indicate so optionally and we will share additional information with you.

Our Values


We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.
We learn and teach: We're dedicated to learning something new every day and, above all, share it.
We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other.
We grow fast: We act fast. We think that the worst mistake is not learning from them.


Perks of being part of our team

We care about people and we also offer a lot of benefits for employees:


High growth, multicultural and friendly environment 🤝
Alan as private health insurance 🩺
Healthy life with Wellhub (Gyms, pools, outdoor classes) 🧘🏽‍♀️
Save expenses with Cobee 💰

Job Description

Title: Technical Analyst, Automation & Reporting

Location: Barcelona, Spain

Reports to: Director, Automation & Reporting

The Role

Dow Jones is seeking a Technical Analyst to join our global Automation & Reporting team, utilizing SQL, Python, and JavaScript to build automation solutions, robust reporting capabilities and manage high volumes of data across Dow Jones products. In this role, you will partner closely with multiple business teams to analyze the databases they own and design innovative technical solutions that automate their core business processes.

As a key technical partner, you will manage a portfolio of deliverables in parallel, bridging the gap between complex business problems and functional technical solutions. You will be responsible for eliciting requirements from stakeholders, translating them into optimized business-centric processes, and effectively communicating progress and blockers to ensure continuous operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities


Solution Design & Development: Design, develop, and maintain optimized solutions to meet reporting and process improvement needs. Write clean, readable code, build highly optimized SQL queries, and develop robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) jobs and tools.
Data Visualization & Interface Design : Design and develop interactive, high-impact dashboards and front-end reporting interfaces. Apply UI/UX best practices to translate complex data sets into clear, accessible, and actionable visual layouts, ensuring a seamless user experience for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
Stakeholder & Portfolio Management: Manage a diverse portfolio of solutions while working closely with multiple stakeholders. Identify high-impact business problems, elicit solution requirements, and effectively communicate progress and blockers to both project teams and executive sponsors.
Process Improvement & Ad-Hoc Support: Design and own business-centric reporting processes that actively improve the organization's operational efficiency. Remain flexible and responsive to ad hoc and urgent reporting requests in a fast-paced environment.
Best Practices & Quality Assurance: Adopt and continuously contribute to the improvement of existing technical best practices. Ensure high standards across solution design, development, validation, and documentation.


Qualifications


Essential Experience: Undergraduate degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics) or equivalent training. Self-starter capable of working independently, coordinating with multiple partners, and driving complex projects from conception to finish.
Technical Proficiency: 3+ years of experience utilizing SQL and Python for data analysis and data processing. Detail-oriented with a strict focus on assuring quality, consistency, and accuracy in data and processes. Proven experience working with version control systems like Git.
Visualization & UI Expertise: Proven hands-on experience with industry-standard BI tools (e.g. Quicksight, Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and front-end UI development (e.g. JavaScript charting libraries, HTML/CSS). Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, wireframing, and building intuitive user interfaces that drive user adoption.
Delivery & Communication: Agile mindset with a track record of successful delivery through agile practices. Exceptional communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Open to different viewpoints with a strong appreciation for team diversity.
Preferred Skills: Experience in ETL development, data visualization, and building dashboards. Familiarity with managing large datasets in a fluid environment and solving complex, non-routine problems. Experience with cloud services such as AWS (including Glue, Athena, S3) or GCP, Google APIs, and other programming languages like JavaScript. Knowledge of AI tools (Copilot, Claude Code), Data Science, and predictive modeling is highly desired.


Our Benefits


Comprehensive Healthcare Plans for you and your family (paid by Dow Jones)
Extra paid Time Off (30 days of holidays/year)
Possibility to work remotely for 3 months/year (desplazamiento program) or one week of remote work per quarter
Meal benefit with Pluxee (171€/month on top of your salary)
Retirement Plans (Dow Jones will pay 2% of a members Pensionable Salary and match employee contribution up to a maximum of 3 %).
Comprehensive Insurance Plans
Well-being Resources (200 USD allowance per quarter, Classpass, etc.)
Family Care Benefits & Caregiving Support
Subscription Discounts
Employee Referral Program


\ Hybrid

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including women, people with disabilities, and those from underrepresented groups.

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Como uno de nuestros Data Scientists de Juegos

Serás una de las personas clave que ayuda a transformar preguntas de negocio en insights accionables. Investigarás y analizarás el comportamiento de los jugadores para generar recomendaciones basadas en datos. Para ello, escucharás a los distintos miembros del equipo, comprenderás el contexto y cuestionarás ideas de negocio cuando sea necesario.

Nuestros Data Scientists utilizan una amplia variedad de técnicas, como estadística frecuentista y bayesiana, machine learning, análisis exploratorio y explicativo de datos, inferencia causal, visualización de datos, modelización Monte Carlo, análisis econométrico, entre otras. La amplitud de estas responsabilidades requiere una gran capacidad de aprendizaje, eficiencia en el trabajo colaborativo y habilidad para comunicar datos e insights de forma clara y efectiva.

Los Data Scientists de Juegos son profesionales que impulsan la toma de decisiones de negocio mediante el uso de datos y análisis profundos.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con conjuntos de datos grandes y complejos, disfrutando de la autonomía necesaria para generar un impacto significativo en el éxito de nuestros juegos. Además, formarás parte de un equipo experimentado y altamente cualificado de aproximadamente 20 profesionales, con múltiples oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

Qué harás
Colaborar con los stakeholders para entender y definir los requisitos de análisis.
Realizar análisis exploratorios de datos y convertir los hallazgos en preguntas que puedan responderse mediante técnicas analíticas.
Utilizar analítica avanzada, métodos estadísticos, inferencia causal, machine learning u otras técnicas para responder preguntas y resolver problemas de negocio.
Comunicar los resultados de forma clara y efectiva.
Gestionar requisitos poco definidos o ambiguos.
Explicar análisis complejos e ideas técnicas de manera sencilla y comprensible.
Trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos complejos.
Mantener una actitud de aprendizaje continuo, adquiriendo nuevas habilidades y metodologías relacionadas con la ciencia de datos, la comunicación o la gestión de stakeholders.
Utilizar una amplia variedad de herramientas y enfoques de ciencia de datos.


Qué buscamos
Titulación universitaria o experiencia equivalente en un área orientada a los datos.
Capacidad para utilizar técnicas de visualización de datos con el fin de comunicar análisis e insights de manera efectiva.
Experiencia utilizando alguna de las siguientes disciplinas para responder preguntas de negocio o científicas: estadística, matemáticas, machine learning, econometría, inferencia causal, modelización Monte Carlo, entre otras.
Experiencia trabajando con R y/o Python.
Conocimientos y experiencia en SQL.


¿Por qué Product Madness?

Como parte de la familia Aristocrat, compartimos su misión de llenar de alegría la vida gracias al poder del juego, con un equipo de primer nivel que crea títulos líderes y de mayor recaudación en el género de casino social, entre ellos Heart of Vegas, Lightning Link y Cashman Casino.

Con un equipo global de 800 personas, Product Madness tiene su sede en Londres, y oficinas en Barcelona, Gdańsk, Lviv, Montreal y un equipo remoto en Estados Unidos, lo que nos convierte en una auténtica potencia global.

Nos guiamos por nuestro principio de “Las personas primero”. Independientemente de dónde, cuándo o cómo trabajen, los miembros de nuestro equipo tienen oportunidades para avanzar en su carrera profesional y crecer con nosotros. Nos enorgullece fomentar una cultura inclusiva, en la que se anima a cada persona a dar lo mejor de sí misma cada día.

Pero no confíes solo en nuestra palabra. En 2024, fuimos incluidos en la lista de los Global Inspiring Workplace Awards y recibimos un premio de bronce en los Stevies for Great Employers, en la categoría de “Empleador del año - Medios de comunicación y entretenimiento”.

Disponibilidad para viajar

Ninguna

Contribuir a la adopción, usabilidad e impacto de las soluciones analíticas dentro de la organización.
Stack y forma de trabajo: SQL, Python, Databricks, dbt, Git y flujos de trabajo con pull requests, Power BI, Excel + GSuite…


Tu perfil


Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, analytics o reporting.
Experiencia definiendo y realizando seguimiento de KPIs y OKRs orientados a negocio.
Nivel sólido de SQL y experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Experiencia práctica trabajando con Python para análisis, transformación y explotación de datos.
Experiencia construyendo dashboards y reporting en Power BI.
Capacidad para entender procesos de negocio y transformarlos en soluciones analíticas útiles.
Mentalidad orientada a producto, mejora continua e impacto en negocio.
Entornos cloud y plataformas modernas de datos
Modelado de datos y analytics engineering

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Sobre Lucta

En Lucta seguimos impulsando la transformación digital de nuestros procesos y buscamos incorporar un/a Business Intelligence Developer para formar parte del equipo de Data & Analytics.

Como Business Intelligence Developer participarás en el desarrollo y evolución de las soluciones analíticas que permiten transformar los datos corporativos en información útil para la toma de decisiones. Colaborarás con diferentes áreas de la compañía, participando en proyectos de integración de datos, desarrollo de modelos analíticos y soluciones de reporting con impacto directo en el negocio.

¿Qué harás en esta posición?

Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:


Analizar requerimientos junto con las áreas de negocio.
Desarrollar y mantener procesos de integración de datos (ETL).
Participar en el desarrollo y evolución de modelos de Data Warehouse y Data Marts.
Diseñar y mantener soluciones de Business Intelligence y Reporting.
Dar soporte funcional y técnico a los usuarios.
Documentar las soluciones desarrolladas y colaborar en la mejora continua de las herramientas del área.


Requisitos:

Formación


Grado o Ingeniería en Informática, Matemáticas, Física o titulaciones afines.


Conocimientos técnicos


SQL.
Procesos ETL.
Data Warehouse y modelado dimensional.
Herramientas de Business Intelligence y Reporting.
Se valorarán conocimientos de SAP BODS, SAP BI, Qlik y tecnologías Big Data.
Nivel medio-alto de inglés.


Competencias clave

Buscamos una persona con:


Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.
Organización y atención al detalle.
Iniciativa y proactividad.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación.
Familiaridad con metodologías ágiles de trabajo (Agile, Scrum).


Lo que buscamos en ti

Queremos incorporar una persona con interés por los datos y la analítica, con ganas de participar en proyectos tecnológicos que aporten valor al negocio. Si disfrutas desarrollando soluciones de Business Intelligence y colaborando con diferentes áreas de la organización, en Lucta encontrarás un entorno donde seguir creciendo profesionalmente.

¡Esperamos tu candidatura!

Description:
Who are we?

At SEAT CODE, we don't just write code; we redefine how the world moves. We are the digital core of SEAT & CUPRA, a hub where the agility of a startup meets the power of a global automotive giant.

Imagine having the creative freedom to experiment, fail fast, and learn daily, while knowing your work will be touched by millions of drivers worldwide. We are the bridge between a legendary automotive heritage and the future of digital experiences. Are you ready to drive the change?

The challenge 🤔

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Commercial Data Insights Team. You will be a member of the technical brain behind the data driven strategy for SEAT and CUPRA. Your role is critical: you ensure that every interaction on our websites and apps is accurately captured and translated into actionable insights.

Your mission 🧐


Lead the design, development, and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into insightful, user-friendly reports and visualizations.
Develop and optimize data models by integrating multiple enterprise data sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ, and others), ensuring high performance and scalability.
Establish and maintain KPI frameworks, data governance standards, and reporting best practices to ensure data accuracy, consistency and reliability.
Perform testing, validation, and quality assurance activities to guarantee the integrity and performance of reporting solutions.
Provide advanced analytical insights and recommendations through data exploration, trend analysis and performance monitoring.
Create and maintain technical documentation while driving continuous improvements in reporting capabilities and user experience.


What we offer 🤩

We believe in a mature and balanced work environment. No fireworks, but solid conditions.


Annual gross salary: 45.000-48.000€.
2.200€ per year in social benefits to choose.
2.000€ per year in trainings.
Daily Snacks: We try to promote healthy living habits. You will find in our canteen many nuts, fresh fruit, salads, …
Flexible working hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance.
26 days for your vacations.
Best technology for your needs.
Nice located offices.


Minimum Requirements

What we’re looking for 😊


Education: Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
Fluency in English and Spanish is required.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence development, with a focus on building semantic models and data analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Proficient in SQL, DAX, Python, or Spark for querying and modelling data.
Experience with ETL tools and data integration (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform).
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) and data warehousing solutions.
Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical teams and stakeholders.
Proven experience in translating business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.
Strong ability to work autonomously and thrive in collaborative environments
Track record of driving innovation and pushing Power BI capabilities while respecting enterprise governance and security guidelines.
Familiarity with AI-driven capabilities in BI (e.g., Power BI Copilot, automated insights, Chatbot, etc.), combined with a strong drive to experiment, innovate and implement AI-focused improvements.
Experience with other visualization tools like Tableau.
Nice to have: Experience working with digital analytics platforms and web/product data integration (e.g. Adobe Analytics).
