Talent Data Analyst & Specialist

Location:

Barcelona, ES Logrono, ES Alzira, ES Lisbon, PT Bristol, GB Lodz, PL

Department: Human Resources

Full-time or Part-time: Full-Time

Job Type: Employee

Shift: On site

Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

About The Role

Shape the future of talent with data, insights, and great experiences.

Are you passionate about using data to improve how people grow and thrive at work? Do you enjoy combining analytical thinking with delivering meaningful talent initiatives?

As our Talent Data & Programs Specialist, you'll play a key role in helping shape talent decisions across our global organization. You'll transform people data into meaningful insights while also supporting the delivery of exciting global talent programs that help our people grow, thrive, and succeed.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data but also wants to collaborate with colleagues around the world, influence talent strategies, and see the real impact of their work.

Key Job Accountabilities

Turn data into meaningful insights


Analyze talent data to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and support strategic talent decisions.
Create engaging dashboards and reports using Excel and Power BI that help leaders understand workforce trends and talent outcomes.
Support key talent initiatives such as talent reviews, succession planning, learning and development, and employee engagement through data-driven insights.
Prepare talent data for internal and external reporting while ensuring accuracy and consistency.
Continuously look for smarter ways to improve reporting, dashboards, and data quality.


Help bring global talent programs to life


Support the Director Global Talent Programs with coordination and delivery of global talent initiatives.
Manage program communications, materials, SharePoint sites, and logistics to create a smooth participant experience.
Collaborate with regional Talent teams, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders to ensure successful program delivery.
Gather feedback and measure program effectiveness to help continuously improve our talent offerings.


Collaborate across a global HR community


Work closely with HRIS, Talent teams, HR Business Partners, and Learning teams across multiple regions.
Translate data into clear, practical recommendations that support leaders in making informed people decisions.
Champion data quality, governance, and responsible handling of employee information.


Qualifications/Requirements

We're looking for someone who's naturally curious, enjoys solving problems, and loves working with both people and data.

You likely bring:


Around 3-5 years of experience in HR Analytics, People Analytics, Talent, or a similar HR role.
Strong Excel and Power BI skills, with the ability to create clear and compelling visualizations.
Experience working with HR systems such as Workday.
An analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into meaningful stories and recommendations.
Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders across different functions and cultures.
Great organization skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
High attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and confidentiality.
Fluency in English.


Nice to have


Experience supporting global talent programs.
Exposure to external reporting.
Certification in Talent Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related field.


Why you'll enjoy this role


Work on global talent initiatives that have real impact on employee growth and engagement.
Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and cultures.
Combine analytical work with hands-on program delivery, giving you a varied and rewarding role.
Grow your expertise in both People Analytics and Global Talent Programs.
Be part of a collaborative team that values curiosity, continuous improvement, and innovation.


About Amcor

Amcor is the global leader in developing and producing responsible consumer packaging and dispensing solutions across a variety of materials for nutrition, health, beauty and wellness categories. Our global product innovation and sustainability expertise enables us to solve packaging challenges around the world every day, producing a range of flexible packaging, rigid packaging, cartons and closures that are more sustainable, functional and appealing for our customers and their consumers. We are guided by our purpose of elevating customers, shaping lives and protecting the future. Supported by a commitment to safety, over 75,000 people generate $23 billion in annualized sales from operations that span over 400 locations in more than 40 countries.

Title: Data Analyst BI
Description:
¿Te apasiona convertir los datos en información que impulse decisiones de negocio? Buscamos un perfil de Data para uno de nuestros clientes.




Buscamos una persona con perfil analítico que quiera participar en la creación de un área de Data & Analytics desde sus inicios, con un papel protagonista y un impacto directo en la organización.




MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Serás la primera incorporación del área de Data & Analytics y trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con la Dirección de IT.




Tu principal objetivo será transformar los datos en una herramienta clave para la toma de decisiones. En una primera etapa, te centrarás en comprender el negocio, estructurar la información disponible y desarrollar dashboards que respondan a las necesidades de las distintas áreas. Posteriormente, evolucionarás hacia un rol con mayor componente analítico, participando en proyectos de modelización y análisis de datos para resolver retos de negocio de mayor complejidad.




¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA?

Business Intelligence

Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar dashboards en Qlik Sense.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en indicadores e informes de valor.
Crear cuadros de mando intuitivos que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Identificar nuevas métricas y oportunidades de mejora en la explotación de la información.




Análisis de datos

Integrar información procedente de múltiples fuentes.
Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos para detectar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades.
Realizar análisis estadísticos y matemáticos orientados a resolver retos de negocio.
Garantizar la calidad y consistencia de los datos utilizados en los análisis.




Construcción del área de Data

Participar activamente en la creación del área de Data & Analytics.
Colaborar con equipos técnicos y de negocio.
Proponer nuevas soluciones, metodologías y mejoras en la gestión del dato.
Evolucionar hacia proyectos analíticos de mayor complejidad e impacto.




¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?

Requisitos

Formación universitaria en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería o titulaciones afines.
Nivel de catalán alto hablado y escrito
Experiencia de nivel medio-senior desarrollando dashboards con Qlik Sense.
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Experiencia integrando y tratando información procedente de diferentes fuentes (CSV, Excel, PostgreSQL, S3 o similares).
Conocimientos de GIT.
Experiencia o conocimientos en DBT.
Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas.

Valorable

Conocimientos de Apache Flink.
Experiencia en modelización de datos.
Conocimientos de análisis estadístico.
Nivel de inglés o francés.




Sobre ti:

Buscamos una persona que destaque por:

Gran capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.
Autonomía para organizar su trabajo y tomar decisiones.
Curiosidad por entender el negocio y profundizar en los datos.
Proactividad e iniciativa para proponer mejoras.
Mentalidad crítica y capacidad para cuestionar procesos existentes.
Responsabilidad y compromiso con la calidad del trabajo.
Ganas de construir y hacer crecer un área de Data desde cero.
Capacidad para colaborar con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.

No buscamos únicamente un perfil orientado al desarrollo de dashboards, sino una persona con criterio propio, vocación analítica y capacidad para aportar ideas y convertirse en una referencia dentro del área.




¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?

La oportunidad de construir un área de Data & Analytics desde sus inicios.
Un proyecto con recorrido y posibilidades reales de crecimiento profesional.
Alto nivel de autonomía y capacidad de influencia en las decisiones técnicas.
Participación directa en proyectos estratégicos para el negocio.
Estabilidad laboral.
Excelente ambiente de trabajo y una cultura cercana y colaborativa.
Modalidad híbrida tras un periodo inicial de incorporación presencial para facilitar el onboarding y el conocimiento del negocio.
Incorporación estable.
Reporte directo a Dirección de IT.

Title: REVENUE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS ANALYST
Description:
LEVEL is a long-haul airline based in Barcelona and part of the IAG group. The company is customer-centric and places a strong emphasis on values such as commitment, an open attitude, a constant drive for improvement, and making travel easy for their customers. With a focus on providing an exceptional customer experience, LEVEL is committed to delivering top-notch service and exceeding the expectations of their passengers

Job Purpose

The RM Systems Specialist supports the Revenue Management team in the day-to-day calibration of the Revenue Management System (RMS), the automation of manual processes, and the development of the KPI framework. This role blends strong data analytics skills with growing expertise in RM systems, enabling the Pricing and Inventory teams to work faster, smarter, and with better data.

The RM Systems Specialist reports to the RM Systems, Processes & KPIs Manager

Main Responsibilities - Tasks2. Process Excellence & Business Automation3. KPI Framework & Performance AuditingEducation


RMS Ownership & Technical Strategy
System Configuration & Calibration: Support the administration and fine-tuning of the Revenue Management Systems (AirRM & PROS), assisting with demand forecasting models, influence factors, and optimizer settings.
Business Rule Management: Support the implementation and validation of RM business rules, ensuring system configurations align with commercial and operational objectives.
Data Integration & Quality Assurance: Validate data flows between the PSS, RMS, and external data sources (e.g., Infare), ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability for Revenue Management processes.
Automation Projects: Design and build automation scripts and tools (SQL, Python, RPA) to eliminate manual, repetitive tasks and free up analyst time for higher-value work.
System Enhancements & Testing: Coordinate and execute functional testing for RM system enhancements, configuration changes, and new releases, ensuring solutions meet business requirements before deployment.
Knowledge Management & Best Practices: Develop and maintain the RM knowledge base, documenting system processes and best practices to ensure consistency and facilitate knowledge sharing across the team.
Dashboard Development: Build and maintain the RM “Health Check” dashboard in Power BI, tracking metrics such as Forecast Accuracy (MAPE), Yield Opportunity Loss, and Spill/Spoilage.
Override Analysis: Support “Post-Mortem” audits on analyst overrides to help measure their value-add versus the system’s baseline.
Data Deep-Dives: Analyze no-show trends, cancellation patterns, and denied boarding data to identify revenue opportunities/leakage points.


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or similar).

Experience

Prior experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or in a similar quantitative role is required; prior experience in Revenue Management, Pricing, or the airline/travel industry is a plus, but not a must

Competencies


System Exposure: Familiarity with RM systems (AirRM, PROS, or similar) and core RM concepts (e.g., EMSRb, Dynamic Pricing) is a plus.


Technical Stack:


SQL: Solid working knowledge (BigQuery, Snowflake, or SQL Server) for data extraction and analysis.
Data Viz: Experience with Power BI or Tableau to build dashboards and automated reports.
Coding: Proficiency in Python or R for automation and predictive modeling is highly valued.
Analytical Mindset: Comfortable investigating why numbers move and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Communication: Able to work closely with both technical teams and commercial stakeholders
Mindset: Analytical, curious, and driven to continuously learn, with a strong interest in developing expertise in RM and supporting data-driven decisions.


Languages


Fluent in English and Spanish


Other

Key Performance Indicators (The "Owner" of these metrics)Location


Forecast Accuracy: Contributing to reducing the delta between predicted and actual demand.
Automation Impact: Number and impact of manual processes automated and analyst hours saved.
Dashboard Reliability: Accuracy and timeliness of KPI dashboards and reports delivered.
Data Integrity: Minimizing discrepancies between PSS, RMS, and BI reporting.


Viladecans, Barcelona

Title: Social Media Analyst (Hospitality)

Buscamos un perfil analítico que no se quede en el reporting, sino que convierta datos en recomendaciones que el negocio realmente use.

Producir y mantener dashboards de rendimiento de social media segmentados por marca, mercado y canal.
Garantizar la calidad, consistencia y puntualidad de los datos en todas las fuentes y herramientas.
Construir benchmarks competitivos y de mercado en las categorías de marca relevantes.
Identificar patrones y tendencias en el comportamiento de audiencias y rendimiento de contenido.
Traducir hallazgos analíticos en briefings claros para Strategists de marca, SocialCare Lead y dirección.
Coordinar metodológicamente con el equipo de Tech & Tools para asegurar consistencia en la definición de métricas y KPIs.
Apoyar el análisis de campañas de awareness: alcance, sentimiento, share of voice y atribución.


Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role


3+ años de experiencia en analítica digital, social media analytics o data analytics en marketing.
Dominio de herramientas de analítica social (Brandwatch, Sprinklr Reporting, Talkwalker o similares).
Solvencia en herramientas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) y hojas de cálculo avanzadas.
Conocimiento sólido de métricas de social media y KPIs de campañas de awareness.
Capacidad de comunicar hallazgos de datos a audiencias no técnicas.
Inglés profesional (entorno de trabajo internacional, coordinación con equipos en distintas regiones).


Valorable


Experiencia construyendo modelos de atribución o análisis de cohortes.
Experiencia en sector turístico, hotelero o retail con operación multimarca o multi mercado.
Conocimiento de SQL o herramientas de manipulación de datos a escala.


Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Data Analyst II Rider Experience
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR WORK-LIFE OPPORTUNITY:

Join our team and become an integral part of Glovo's Global Logistics! We provide a dynamic and challenging environment filled with numerous opportunities for growth and development.

In this role, you will be responsible for redesigning, testing, and implementing the payment structures that motivate and reward our riders worldwide. By blending deep data analysis and data modeling with creative problem-solving, your work will ensure our logistics network is efficient, scalable, and fair for our riders. The KPIs you will influence are crucial to operations, as every decision made will directly affect the whole operational investment (biggest company cost).

Be a Part Of a Team Where You Will


Explore and find the most optimal logistics payment structure in order to maximize global riders engagement.
Strategically redesign our courier payment framework to improve key operational metrics, designing models that reward factors like vehicle used, distance, weight, and peak-hour availability.
Dive deep into massive datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Your insights will be the foundation for optimizing our entire operational investment.
Own the experimentation process to validate your ideas. You will design, run, and analyze experiments (A/B testing, switchback tests) to precisely measure the impact of payment structure changes before a global rollout.
Continuously monitor the performance of your strategies. You will track KPIs, assess the effectiveness of your changes, and make data-driven adjustments as needed.
Understand and address local and regional needs by stepping into the shoes of the riders and truly understanding their perspective.


Qualifications

YOU HAVE


Degree in Engineering, Maths or another STEM field.
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role where you translated insights into tangible business actions and measured their impact.
Strong technical proficiency
Advanced SQL for complex querying and data extraction.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and data orchestration.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.
Nice to have experience with experimentation. Designing and/or analyzing A/B tests or other statistical testing methodologies to measure impact.
Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.
You can clearly and concisely explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English is a must.
You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Additional Information

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.


At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Fraud Data Analyst, you'll be the person who secures the future of digital payments by architecting sophisticated real-time defense strategies.

Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.

Title: Junior Data Analyst & AI Automation Specialist
Description:
En Rubió llevamos más de 55 años trabajando para que todas las personas tengan acceso a nuestros medicamentos, independientemente de la prevalencia de su patología, contribuyendo así a mejorar su calidad de vida.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst & Automation Specialist para Nutribrain, una compañía especializada en la fabricación y comercialización de suplementos alimenticios naturales, orientados al bienestar mental y físico, la nutrición y la mejora de la calidad de vida, con una fuerte apuesta por la innovación, la investigación y la calidad en el ámbito de la salud.




La posición estará ubicada en Barcelona y se integrará en un equipo pequeño y ágil, donde los datos tienen un papel clave en la toma de decisiones. La persona seleccionada trabajará directamente con el CEO, con autonomía y margen para proponer y desarrollar soluciones.




¿Cuál será tu rol?




La persona seleccionada tendrá un rol dinámico y transversal, combinando análisis de datos, desarrollo de herramientas y automatización de procesos.




Será responsable de transformar datos en información útil para el negocio y de desarrollar soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y automatizar procesos, trabajando con datos de ventas, previsiones, stock y diferentes plataformas y marketplaces.




Además del análisis técnico, la persona será capaz de interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio, entendiendo el impacto de variables como ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, stock, rotación de producto y previsiones, para aportar recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.




Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a diferentes áreas del negocio, participando en el desarrollo de soluciones y herramientas propias.




Funciones principales




Análisis de datos y automatización

Analizar datos de negocio, incluyendo ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales, identificando tendencias, estacionalidades e inconsistencias.
Desarrollar dashboards y herramientas de visualización que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y desarrollar automatizaciones e integraciones entre plataformas, APIs y bases de datos.
Crear flujos de datos automatizados y herramientas propias para obtener información de fuentes sin API oficial, mediante web scraping y automatización de navegadores.
Desarrollar aplicaciones y soluciones internas adaptadas a las necesidades del negocio.
Interpretar indicadores de negocio relacionados con ventas, rentabilidad, stock y catálogo de producto, identificando oportunidades de mejora y apoyando la toma de decisiones desde una perspectiva financiera y comercial.




IA y desarrollo de nuevas soluciones

Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a procesos y necesidades reales del negocio.
Integrar modelos de lenguaje y herramientas de IA en flujos de trabajo y automatizaciones.
Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones de IA audiovisual para generación de vídeo, voz e imagen.
Identificar nuevas oportunidades de automatización y proponer soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y aportar valor al negocio.




¿Qué requisitos buscamos?




Formación y experiencia: 2-4 años de experiencia en análisis de datos aplicado a negocio, con capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos y entornos dinámicos.
Análisis de datos: sólida capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico, con experiencia en análisis de ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales.
Programación y datos: buen dominio de SQL y Python (pandas), experiencia con datasets reales, Git/GitHub y APIs REST.
Automatización: experiencia con web scraping, automatización de navegadores y herramientas de integración y automatización de procesos.
Herramientas y tecnología: nivel avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y, valorable, experiencia con herramientas de BI, bases de datos, n8n, Make, Zapier o tecnologías similares.
IA y nuevas tecnologías: Dominio de asistentes de programación y desarrollo basados en IA, como Codex, Claude Code, Cursor o herramientas similares, utilizándolos de forma habitual para acelerar el desarrollo y la automatización, curiosidad por mantenerse al día de la evolución de los modelos de IA, nuevas capacidades y herramientas emergentes, evaluando su aplicación práctica en el entorno empresarial.
Perfil personal: persona resolutiva, autónoma, organizada y con capacidad para gestionar proyectos propios y encontrar soluciones ante nuevos retos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación estable.
Presencial de lunes, miércoles y jueves en oficinas de Barcelona.
Martes y viernes con posibilidad de teletrabajo.
Viernes con jornada intensiva.
Incorporación a un equipo en crecimiento con oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional.




Si crees que encajas con el perfil y quieres formar parte de un equipo comprometido con la innovación y la excelencia, ¡te estamos buscando!




Si quieres saber más sobre nosotros, visita nuestra web:




www.laboratoriosrubio.com

https://www.nutribrain.eu/

Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. About The Role

Shape the future of talent with data, insights, and great experiences.

Are you passionate about using data to improve how people grow and thrive at work? Do you enjoy combining analytical thinking with delivering meaningful talent initiatives?

As our Talent Data & Programs Specialist, you'll play a key role in helping shape talent decisions across our global organization. You'll transform people data into meaningful insights while also supporting the delivery of exciting global talent programs that help our people grow, thrive, and succeed.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data but also wants to collaborate with colleagues around the world, influence talent strategies, and see the real impact of their work.

Key Job Accountabilities

Turn data into meaningful insights


Analyze talent data to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and support strategic talent decisions.
Create engaging dashboards and reports using Excel and Power BI that help leaders understand workforce trends and talent outcomes.
Support key talent initiatives such as talent reviews, succession planning, learning and development, and employee engagement through data-driven insights.
Prepare talent data for internal and external reporting while ensuring accuracy and consistency.
Continuously look for smarter ways to improve reporting, dashboards, and data quality.


Help bring global talent programs to life


Support the Director Global Talent Programs with coordination and delivery of global talent initiatives.
Manage program communications, materials, SharePoint sites, and logistics to create a smooth participant experience.
Collaborate with regional Talent teams, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders to ensure successful program delivery.
Gather feedback and measure program effectiveness to help continuously improve our talent offerings.


Collaborate across a global HR community


Work closely with HRIS, Talent teams, HR Business Partners, and Learning teams across multiple regions.
Translate data into clear, practical recommendations that support leaders in making informed people decisions.
Champion data quality, governance, and responsible handling of employee information.


Qualifications/Requirements

We're looking for someone who's naturally curious, enjoys solving problems, and loves working with both people and data.

You likely bring:


Around 3-5 years of experience in HR Analytics, People Analytics, Talent, or a similar HR role.
Strong Excel and Power BI skills, with the ability to create clear and compelling visualizations.
Experience working with HR systems such as Workday.
An analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into meaningful stories and recommendations.
Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders across different functions and cultures.
Great organization skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
High attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and confidentiality.
Fluency in English.


Nice to have


Experience supporting global talent programs.
Exposure to external reporting.
Certification in Talent Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related field.


Why you'll enjoy this role


Work on global talent initiatives that have real impact on employee growth and engagement.
Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and cultures.
Combine analytical work with hands-on program delivery, giving you a varied and rewarding role.
Grow your expertise in both People Analytics and Global Talent Programs.
Be part of a collaborative team that values curiosity, continuous improvement, and innovation.


About Amcor

Amcor is the global leader in developing and producing responsible consumer packaging and dispensing solutions across a variety of materials for nutrition, health, beauty and wellness categories. Our global product innovation and sustainability expertise enables us to solve packaging challenges around the world every day, producing a range of flexible packaging, rigid packaging, cartons and closures that are more sustainable, functional and appealing for our customers and their consumers. We are guided by our purpose of elevating customers, shaping lives and protecting the future. Supported by a commitment to safety, over 75,000 people generate $23 billion in annualized sales from operations that span over 400 locations in more than 40 countries.

As our data & yield analyst reporting to the Director of Advertising, you will be responsible for bridging all revenue team’s data-analytics need (including but not limited to datasets, data visualization, and automation with the process for revenue generation/optimization purposes) with our BI team, to drive initiatives that will boost making more & better data-driven decisions and improve efficiency on revenue generation. Be a data champion inside the Advertising & RevOps team and the go-to-person for ithe team & stakeholders from other revenue teams when it comes to better utilization of our data.

Manage UPR optimisation and automation of pricing recommendation tool (either 3rd party or in-house).

At least 2 years of working experience working as business analyst, preferably with experience in digital advertising business.
Experience of working with BI platforms, like Tableau, Qlikview & advance skills of Google Analytics.
Experience of doing data analysis work with AI tools like Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, etc.
Experience of working with BigQuery, SQL & Python.
Preferable background on big data, data science related topics.
Experience building analytical models and working with structured and unstructured data sets to drive business decisions.
Knowledge of the online advertising ecosystem.
Basic understanding of budgeting, financial forecast, and accounting principles is preferred.
Excellent communication and project management skills with a strong business acumen.
Ability to work on own initiative in a fast-moving environment.
High level of motivation, determination and commitment.
An excellent command of both written and spoken English is required.

Title: Revenue Analyst - Four Seasons Mallorca at Formentor
Description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor, perched on the spectacular Formentor Peninsula and surrounded by panoramic views of the Mediterranean and the stunning landscape, first opened its doors in August 2024 following an extensive restoration and renovation of the historic property, originally inaugurated in 1929 on a vast private estate. After its successful debut, the resort will reopen to guests in March 2025, reaffirming its status as a unique destination of luxury and elegance on the island.

About The Role

The Revenue Analyst will be working with the Director of Revenue to define, design, develop and execute business reports and analyses that establish actionable business insights into the performance of both brand level and property specific revenue trends and opportunities.

What You Will Do


Strategy Support: By assisting the Director of Revenue Management with essential administrative duties and fulfil reporting and analysis tasks, it will ensure that the RM strategies as defined by the team can be executed in an efficient and pro-active manner. Providing contingency along with the Reservations Manager in the event of absence is also an element in the delivery of strategy objectives.
Closely monitor competitive pricing and understand the impact of relative pricing decisions on property performance. Perform competitor checks and report as appropriate.
Assist the DORM in identifying soft periods and developing promotions and strategies.
Support the DORM in effective implementation of Four Seasons Revenue Management Standards, Policies & Procedures. (Rate Plans, Rate Categories, Market Segmentation, Profiles, and all other PMS/ORS related RM functionality.)
Action Rate Solicitations as directed and maintain rate plans.
Ensure the hotel has Best Rate Guarantee compliance, and work with the DORM to minimize/eliminate rate parity claims against the hotel.
Assist the DORM with daily updates of the Revenue Management Reports and ensure all data input into the system is accurate. (Geo Source, Product Quality, Pricing). Opportunity to assist with all aspects of budget preparation.
Assist in the preparation of 30-60-90 day fully updated Forecasts. Work with the DORM to prepare longer term forecasts and achieve hotel forecast accuracy goals.
Participate in the property’s weekly Strategy Meeting and contribute to the Daily Operations Meeting.
Review and analyze data on an ongoing and end of month basis. Provide monthly reports on production, trends, booking and stay patterns as well as channel analysis. Evaluation of the distribution channel performance and potential reasons for this performance.
Analyze competitive reports and formulate appropriate suggestions for strategies through use of STR Reports.
Daily communication with our Reservations and Front Office and Sales team to share best practices.

Laurea Magistrale in discipline quantitative (Statistica, Matematica, Data Science, Ingegneria) o in Economia con un forte indirizzo quantitativo/analitico
Esperienza nel ruolo in contesti strutturati
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese
Conoscenza di SQL per l'estrazione, manipolazione e pulizia di database complessi
Buona padronanza di Python per l'analisi dati e la modellazione di Machine Learning
Spiccate capacità di Business Acumen e Data Storytelling (saper presentare i dati rendendoli comprensibili e utili per chi deve prendere decisioni)


Nice To Have


Conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence e Data Visualization (preferibilmente Looker, o in alternativa PowerBI /Qlik)
Familiarità con ecosistemi Cloud, in particolare Google Cloud Platform
Conoscenza di base sulle architetture AI/LLM/Agentic
Basi di containerizzazione e deployment (Docker)


Potrebbe essere l'inizio della tua avventura con noi!

In OVS SpA troverai un'azienda strutturata, un ambiente dinamico e fortemente orientato al risultato. Stiamo innovando la tradizione, con un forte investimento sulle nuove tecnologie, per offrire a clienti e dipendenti un'esperienza sempre più completa e digitale, senza trascurare l'attenzione per l'ambiente, il futuro e la sostenibilità.

Somos una empresa tecnológica española que está transformando el mercado de segunda mano. Comprar online es fácil, pero ¿qué pasa con vender lo que ya no necesitas? En Hamelyn, hacemos que vender tus cosas usadas sea rápido y sin complicaciones. Y las revendemos dando un servicio profesional.




Empezamos con libros, y ya hemos añadido música, películas y videojuegos. Y próximamente tendremos nuevas categorías. Ambicionamos ser la aplicación a la que todos acuden para vender sin complicaciones y para comprar productos de segunda mano con el mismo nivel de calidad y servicio que al comprar productos nuevos.




Hoy, Hamelyn atiende a miles de vendedores y compradores diariamente, procesando cientos de miles de productos al mes y enviando pedidos de todas nuestras categorías desde nuestro centro logístico de Madrid a todo el mundo.

Si quieres saber más sobre la historia de Hamelyn, aquí tienes la entrevista de Itnig a nuestros fundadores: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MGkTWW2rVAc&t=10s




Ahora estamos creciendo rápidamente y construyendo una infraestructura de datos a la altura del negocio. Necesitamos un Data Analytics Engineer que trabaje mano a mano con el Data Lead.




🚀¿Listo para construir el futuro con Hamelyn?🚀

Buscamos un experto en datos, perfeccionista con la calidad y la fiabilidad de la información, con experiencia tanto en infraestructura como en análisis de datos. Reportarás al Data Lead.




🎯 Misión:

Mejorar y escalar los sistemas de datos de Hamelyn y analizarlos para impulsar decisiones de negocio y mejoras en producto y tecnología.




🔥 En qué trabajarás:

Operamos en múltiples países con más de 30 millones de productos catalogados e integrados con marketplaces como Amazon, eBay y MercadoLibre. Esto es lo que tenemos por delante:

Analizar datos clave del negocio para detectar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades (pricing, catálogo, conversión, supply, operaciones).
Definir y mantener métricas y fuentes de verdad (dashboards, tablas base, documentación) para que el equipo tome decisiones rápido.
Construir y mejorar pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) y modelos de datos listos para análisis (data marts), con foco en fiabilidad y rapidez.
Mantener y mejorar bases de datos, data quality y automatizar procesos de reporting.
Apoyar en la construcción y validación de modelos analíticos o predictivos: preparación de datasets, features, validaciones y medición de impacto.
Colaborar con producto y negocio para traducir preguntas en hipótesis, experimentos y decisiones medibles.




Requisitos clave:

Buen dominio de SQL y Python para análisis, automatizaciones y manejo de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con datos en entornos reales: análisis, modelado, pipelines y mantenimiento de fuentes.
Capacidad para convertir datos en decisiones: plantear hipótesis, medir impacto, comunicar hallazgos y proponer acciones.
Bases sólidas en estadística aplicada (tests, segmentación, cohortes, funnels).
Mentalidad hands-on, autonomía y buena comunicación con stakeholders no técnicos.
Experiencia construyendo y/o usando modelos analíticos o predictivos (forecasting, scoring, clasificación, recomendación).
Experiencia en product analytics / growth analytics (experimentos, atribución, conversión, retención).
Buen criterio para definir métricas (North Star, guardrails) y diseñar reporting útil y accionable.
MongoDB.
Experiencia en cloud (GCP, AWS o Azure): despliegue de pipelines, gestión de servicios gestionados de datos y buenas prácticas de IAM/costes.
Experiencia con algún warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar) y buenas prácticas de versionado/CI.




Qué ofrecemos:

Salario altamente competitivo según experiencia.
Modelo híbrido orientado a productividad.
Servicio de comida y gimnasio.
Presupuesto de formación continua.
Sin burocracia, enfoque a resultados.
Un equipo joven, pragmático y ambicioso centrado en resultados reales y en hacer crecer el negocio.




Si buscas un proyecto ambicioso donde aplicar tus capacidades con resultados visibles, y seguir creciendo en una empresa de rápida expansión, te estamos esperando! 🙌

Title: Data Analyst - People & Product
Description:
Hi! 👋

At Factorial we're on the lookout for a Data Analyst to raise the bar on how we turn data into decisions across the business 🚀.

The Role ✨

At Factorial, data sits at the heart of every decision we make — and we're looking for a Data Analyst to make it count where it matters most: our people.

This is a hybrid role that combines two profiles — the responsibilities of an Analytics Engineer and those of a Data Analyst. As an Analytics Engineer, you model and structure data in the gold layer with DBT, turning raw tables into reliable, documented models a whole business area can trust. As a Data Analyst, you build advanced analysis on top of them, own the metrics they expose, and deliver the reporting the business runs on — carrying out dashboards and ad-hoc deep-dives that turn open questions into decisions, hand in hand with Business.

You'll focus primarily on our People area — our biggest opportunity — bringing a data-driven approach to how we understand, hire, and grow our teams, and shaping high-stakes decisions across talent acquisition, headcount planning, engagement, and performance. You'll also partner with Product, helping define how we iterate the product and turning data into real impact on pricing, packaging, and usage.

Factorial is a fast-paced scale-up in constant evolution — some areas are still building their data foundations while others are already driven by the power of data . You won't inherit a finished playbook; you'll write it, raising the analytical bar as the company grows. If you're driven by curiosity, energized by ambiguity, and want ownership of both the data model and the decisions it drives, this one's for you

What You'll Be Doing


Own the data models: Design, build, and maintain the gold-layer models (DBT) that become the single source of truth for your business area — with the tests and documentation that keep them trusted and reused across teams.
Own metrics and governance: Define and document your area's KPIs, resolve conflicting definitions across teams, and maintain a single source of truth others are expected to use.
Treat dashboards as a product: Build reporting in Power BI with clear ownership, and keep iterating on it based on how it's actually used.
Go beyond dashboards: Run the advanced analysis that answers the "why" — cohort and retention analyses, impact modeling, and scenario / forecasting — and turn findings into concrete product, pricing, or lifecycle recommendations.
Enable decision-making: Partner with Business and Product teams to turn ambiguous questions into the right analysis, and run the work that determines whether a decision actually moved the needle.
Foster business–data collaboration: Embed with your stakeholders, build a shared language around metrics, and strengthen how the business and the Data team work together — so data becomes a habit, not an afterthought.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics Engineers to keep data integrity high, prepare the layer models consume, and translate model outputs into metrics the business understands.
Master data storytelling: Turn analysis into clear narratives that align stakeholders and inspire action — so the work actually changes what people do.


What We're Looking For

You're likely a great fit if you:


Have 3+ years in Analytics Engineering, BI, or Data Analyst roles — ideally in a fast-paced, scaling tech environment.
Write fluent, independent SQL — you can model and debug complex queries on your own, without waiting on review.
Are comfortable with Python for analysis and lightweight data workflows.
Know your way around DBT and a layered / medallion modeling approach (bronze / silver / gold).
Have shipped a BI tool in production, Power BI ideally (or an equivalent like Looker / Tableau).
Have solid advanced-analytics fundamentals: cohort and retention analysis, segmentation, funnel and driver analysis, and experimentation (A/B) backed by a solid statistics background.
Use version control (Git / GitHub) as part of your normal workflow.
Are business-minded and communicate with impact — you understand what stakeholders really need (not just what they ask for), reframe the question, and translate complex data into clear, actionable insight that drives decisions.
Are autonomous, proactive, and detail-oriented — you see ambiguity as an opportunity, not a blocker.
Treat the metrics and models you build as products, not one-off deliverables.
Have English working proficiency.


Bonus Points if You:


Understand subscription or product-based (SaaS) economics and can connect data work to revenue, growth, and retention outcomes.
Have owned a metrics framework that became the reference.
Have partnered closely with Data Science to bring models into production and translate their output into business decisions.
Have helped build or scale an analytics function — tooling, modeling and documentation standards, processes, and KPI frameworks — leaving it more mature than you found it.
Have delivered visible impact in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment, bringing structure to ambiguity and moving decisions forward.
Have a quantitative background (degree or equivalent practical depth) you apply to real business problems.


If you're ready to take on this challenge at Factorial, apply now! We can't wait to see what you'll bring to our team. 🌟

Compensation 💰

The salary range for this position is [42800 - 53500 ]€ total compensation + ESOP plan. We won't consider how many years of experience you have but your knowledge and skills.

We care about people, and we also offer employee benefits.

About Factorial 🚀

At Factorial, we’re building the leading AI Business Management Software for companies of all sizes. Our platform centralizes key workflows across HR, Finance, Talent, Operations, and IT, freeing teams from manual processes so they can focus on what really matters: leading, growing, and taking care of their people.With over 1,500 employees across Europe, Asia, Africa, and America. We are one of Europe’s fastest-growing SaaS companies, proudly headquartered in Barcelona. If you're excited to shape the future of business management technology, we’d love to meet you.

We believe in diverse talent: we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of diverse experiences and identities to apply.

We believe in inclusion: we are committed to equal opportunities and actively promote workplace inclusion of people with disabilities. If you would like to learn more about our inclusive recruitment processes, you are welcome to indicate so optionally and we will share additional information with you.

Our Values


We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.
We learn and teach: We're dedicated to learning something new every day and, above all, share it.
We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other.
We grow fast: We act fast. We think that the worst mistake is not learning from them.


Perks of being part of our team

We care about people and we also offer a lot of benefits for employees:


High growth, multicultural and friendly environment 🤝
Alan as private health insurance 🩺
Healthy life with Wellhub (Gyms, pools, outdoor classes) 🧘🏽‍♀️
Save expenses with Cobee 💰
Language classes 👩🏽‍🏫
Breakfast in the office and organic fruit 🍏
Nora discounts 🍱
Free caffeine and theine ☕
Pet Friendly 🐕

Job Description

Title: Technical Analyst, Automation & Reporting

Location: Barcelona, Spain

Reports to: Director, Automation & Reporting

The Role

Dow Jones is seeking a Technical Analyst to join our global Automation & Reporting team, utilizing SQL, Python, and JavaScript to build automation solutions, robust reporting capabilities and manage high volumes of data across Dow Jones products. In this role, you will partner closely with multiple business teams to analyze the databases they own and design innovative technical solutions that automate their core business processes.

As a key technical partner, you will manage a portfolio of deliverables in parallel, bridging the gap between complex business problems and functional technical solutions. You will be responsible for eliciting requirements from stakeholders, translating them into optimized business-centric processes, and effectively communicating progress and blockers to ensure continuous operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities


Solution Design & Development: Design, develop, and maintain optimized solutions to meet reporting and process improvement needs. Write clean, readable code, build highly optimized SQL queries, and develop robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) jobs and tools.
Data Visualization & Interface Design : Design and develop interactive, high-impact dashboards and front-end reporting interfaces. Apply UI/UX best practices to translate complex data sets into clear, accessible, and actionable visual layouts, ensuring a seamless user experience for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
Stakeholder & Portfolio Management: Manage a diverse portfolio of solutions while working closely with multiple stakeholders. Identify high-impact business problems, elicit solution requirements, and effectively communicate progress and blockers to both project teams and executive sponsors.
Process Improvement & Ad-Hoc Support: Design and own business-centric reporting processes that actively improve the organization's operational efficiency. Remain flexible and responsive to ad hoc and urgent reporting requests in a fast-paced environment.
Best Practices & Quality Assurance: Adopt and continuously contribute to the improvement of existing technical best practices. Ensure high standards across solution design, development, validation, and documentation.


Qualifications


Essential Experience: Undergraduate degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics) or equivalent training. Self-starter capable of working independently, coordinating with multiple partners, and driving complex projects from conception to finish.
Technical Proficiency: 3+ years of experience utilizing SQL and Python for data analysis and data processing. Detail-oriented with a strict focus on assuring quality, consistency, and accuracy in data and processes. Proven experience working with version control systems like Git.
Visualization & UI Expertise: Proven hands-on experience with industry-standard BI tools (e.g. Quicksight, Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and front-end UI development (e.g. JavaScript charting libraries, HTML/CSS). Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, wireframing, and building intuitive user interfaces that drive user adoption.
Delivery & Communication: Agile mindset with a track record of successful delivery through agile practices. Exceptional communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Open to different viewpoints with a strong appreciation for team diversity.
Preferred Skills: Experience in ETL development, data visualization, and building dashboards. Familiarity with managing large datasets in a fluid environment and solving complex, non-routine problems. Experience with cloud services such as AWS (including Glue, Athena, S3) or GCP, Google APIs, and other programming languages like JavaScript. Knowledge of AI tools (Copilot, Claude Code), Data Science, and predictive modeling is highly desired.


Our Benefits


Comprehensive Healthcare Plans for you and your family (paid by Dow Jones)
Extra paid Time Off (30 days of holidays/year)
Possibility to work remotely for 3 months/year (desplazamiento program) or one week of remote work per quarter
Meal benefit with Pluxee (171€/month on top of your salary)
Retirement Plans (Dow Jones will pay 2% of a members Pensionable Salary and match employee contribution up to a maximum of 3 %).
Comprehensive Insurance Plans
Well-being Resources (200 USD allowance per quarter, Classpass, etc.)
Family Care Benefits & Caregiving Support
Subscription Discounts
Employee Referral Program


\ Hybrid

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including women, people with disabilities, and those from underrepresented groups.

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at talentresourceteam@dowjones.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

Non-Union role

For bonus-eligible roles, targets are determined based on multiple considerations, including market benchmarks and individual contributions.

Olin nace con la ambición de consolidar, profesionalizar y hacer crecer a un grupo de operadores locales que ponen foco en la cercanía, la calidad del servicio y la sencillez de sus productos.

Queremos ser un referente en dar acceso a conexiones de alta velocidad tanto en el mercado mayorista como minorista y actualmente estamos en pleno crecimiento y expansión en España.

Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo en Olin, empresa del grupo OlinGroup, buscamos incorporar un/a Business Analyst que actúe como enlace directo entre la operadora y el Departamento de Analítica del grupo.

La persona seleccionada tendrá un papel clave en el seguimiento del rendimiento comercial, la fiabilidad de los datos, y el soporte analítico diario a los equipos comerciales, administración y técnico contribuyendo de forma directa a la toma de decisiones operativas y estratégicas.

Funciones y responsabilidades:


Mantenimiento, actualización y evolución de los tableros de Power BI, excels o reportes utilizados para el seguimiento de los KPIs principales de negocio y operativa
Apoyo a los/as responsables de las distintas áreas. Análisis rápidos y resolución de dudas relacionadas con fuentes de datos, métricas y resultados.
Elaboración de informes ad hoc para el seguimiento operativo y la toma de decisiones rápidas.
Generación de BBDD para la realización de acciones concretas y recurrentes así como definir, construir y mantener el reporte de dichas acciones.
Mantenimiento funcional y evolutivo de las aplicaciones desarrolladas en AppSheet (u otras soluciones en el futuro) utilizadas por los agentes comerciales.
Coordinación con el Departamento de Analítica de Grupo para asegurar la coherencia de los datos.


Requisitos:


Grado en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, o similar. Valorable formación específica en Business Intelligence o Data Analytics.
Experiencia previa (min. 1 año) como analista de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con Power BI en entornos de negocio ((modelado, DAX, visualización y mantenimiento de dashboards).
Experiencia en sectores comerciales u orientados a ventas (muy valorable en telecomunicaciones).
Buen manejo de Excel y bases de datos.
Experiencia o familiaridad con AppSheet y/o PowerApps.
Capacidad para trabajar con datos operativos y comerciales.

Contrato indefinido a jornada completa

Title: Data Analyst Strategy Spain
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

As a Data Analyst for Spain, you will be the analytical engine behind Glovo’s largest and most complex market. This isn't a "back-office" role; you will be the primary data partner for every major department in the country—from Commercial and Logistics to Finance and Global Affairs.

Your mission is to own the data lifecycle for the Spanish territory. You will translate massive datasets into strategic clarity, building the BigQuery pipelines and Python models that allow our leadership to make high-stakes decisions in real-time. If you have the technical grit to automate complex ETL processes and the communication skills to influence stakeholders across 7+ departments, this is your ride.

THE JOURNEY


Build the Backbone: Design and maintain robust ETL processes and data models within BigQuery, ensuring the Spanish team has a single, reliable source of truth.
Empower Through Visualization: Create high-impact dashboards in Looker and Tableau that allow stakeholders to monitor performance and spot trends at a glance.
Solve the "Why": Use Python and SQL to perform deep-dive analyses on delivery efficiency, marketing ROI, and commercial growth, turning raw numbers into actionable business strategies.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a data consultant for Spain’s departmental leads, helping them define KPIs, automate manual reporting, and foster a data-first culture.
Scale the Largest Market: Continuously optimize our data infrastructure to handle the unique scale of the Spanish market (our #1 country), ensuring our systems grow as fast as our ambitions.


Qualifications

MUST HAVE


Tools: 0–1 years expert SQL (BigQuery preferred) and strong Python for data manipulation/automation.
Vision: Proven experience building/maintaining ETL processes; able to structure data for scale.
Storytelling: "Data Artist" mindset, hands-on Looker/Tableau experience to visualize complex data for non-technical audiences.
Background: Mid-level experience (approx. 2–3 years) in a high-growth tech, marketplace, or analytical consultancy environment.
Communication: Professional English & Spanish fluency; ability to easily explain technical issues to Finance/Logistics leads.
Foundation: Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar).


Additional Information

At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

Title: Data Consultant
Place: La Rioja, Autonomía de La Rioja, Spain
Description:
En SDG Group llevamos más de 30 años convirtiendo datos en impacto real. Somos una consultora global 100% especializada en Data, Analytics e Inteligencia Artificial, referente del sector según Gartner, Penteo y Everest Group.




Somos especialistas, y eso nos da una profundidad técnica y un conocimiento de negocio que marcan la diferencia en la transformación data-driven de nuestros clientes: más de 1.000 proyectos desarrollados anualmente, equipos altamente especializados y soluciones que llegan a producción.




Todo ello sustentado en nuestro Triple Expertise: visión de negocio, conocimiento tecnológico profundo y alianzas tecnológicas (Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GCP, entre otras). Una combinación que nos ha llevado a trabajar con clientes del IBEX-35 y Fortune 500, contando con presencia global y más de 2.000 personas en todo el mundo.




Si quieres crecer en el mundo del dato, este es el lugar.







¿Cuál será tu misión?

Participarás en el diseño y desarrollo de cuadros de mando desde cero (con tecnologías como PowerBI, Qlik, Tableau o similares) al igual que en el diseño y desarrollo de procesos de modelado de datos y transformación de datos con diferentes ETL's.
Participarás en el análisis funcional de los proyectos, lo que te permitirá entender el negocio y tener una visión global y mayor conocimiento de los clientes.
Realizarás una visualización previa del cuadro de mando para indicar los pasos a seguir de cara al diseño del mismo.
Irás ganando mayor conocimiento y responsabilidad lo que te permitirá participar en más fases de los distintos proyectos.
Te encargarás de la formación de usuarios con el fin de que el cliente sepa interpretar los datos de la mejor manera posible.
Tendrás un mayor posicionamiento de cara al cliente con constante interlocución y dando soluciones a sus necesidades.
Te mantendrás actualizado en las últimas tendencias tecnológicas en el ámbito de Data & Analytics para poder ofrecer las mejores soluciones a nuestros clientes







¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición?

Estudios en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ciencia de datos, Industriales, o contar con un Ciclo Superior u otra salida académica que te haya dotado de capacidad de desarrollo y pensamiento crítico en este ambiente.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años trabajando con diferentes herramientas de Data.
Valorable conocimientos en herramientas cloud.
Valoraremos muy positivamente formación adicional en Analytics, Big Data, o alguna disciplina similar.
Buenas habilidades comunicativas ya qué, poco a poco, irás ganando peso en la parte funcional y en el trato con cliente.
Que seas capaz de trabajar con autonomía y que puedas gestionar tu propio tiempo de la manera más efectiva posible, también, que seas capaz de organizar a otros compañerxs ya que queremos que vayas ganando más responsabilidad.
Como trabajamos en un entorno global, ¡será un plus que puedas comunicarte en inglés!







¿Qué nos hace diferentes?

Aquí no somos una empresa más... ¡somos un equipo que va a por todas!

La tecnología y los datos son nuestra esencia: No solo trabajamos con lo último del mercado, sino que te formaremos para que domines las herramientas más innovadoras en proyectos punteros y de nueva construcción con alto impacto. Además, contamos con un área de innovación donde exploramos nuevas alianzas y centros de I+D.
Crecimiento y plan de carrera: Contarás con revisiones salariales semestrales o anuales, según la categoría profesional, y un desarrollo basado en meritocracia, con posibilidad de evolucionar hacia un camino más técnico o hacia posiciones de liderazgo y management.
Aprendizaje y trabajo en equipo: Formarás parte de equipos con amplia experiencia tanto técnica como de negocio, en un entorno colaborativo donde podrás apoyarte en otros profesionales, aprender de referentes y desarrollarte constantemente.
Diversidad con propósito: La adhesión a la Carta de la Diversidad en España refleja el compromiso con los principios europeos de igualdad, diversidad e inclusión en el entorno laboral. Diferentes perspectivas, mejores soluciones.







Y además, disfrutarás de…

Posición estable y con proyección: tendrás la oportunidad de construir tu carrera a largo plazo, en proyectos de Data & Analytics que generan impacto de verdad.
Flexibilidad: Modelo de trabajo híbrido adaptado a las necesidades del equipo, con posibilidad de modalidad 100% remoto según la ubicación.
Jornada intensiva los viernes y durante julio y agosto.
Salario acorde a tu formación y experiencia.
Apoyo económico para el teletrabajo.
Formación continua: certificaciones oficiales, conferencias, workshops y cursos.
Retribución flexible: ticket restaurante, ticket guardería, ayuda al transporte y seguro médico privado con Mapfre, extensible a tu familia.

En nuestra web corporativa.
Nuestras publicaciones y contenido en Medium.
En nuestras redes sociales: Instagram, LinkedIn y YouTube.

Title: Data Engineering & Analytics Associate
Description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for a Data Engineering & Analytics Associate with +3 years of experience to join our international Data and Analytics team, based in Barcelona.

Who we are:

Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering Big Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.

What we offer:


Interact with senior stakeholders at our clients on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change
Become the go-to person for end-to-end data handling, management, and analytics processes
Working with Data Scientists to take data throughout its lifecycle - acquisition, exploration, data cleaning, integration, analysis, interpretation and visualization
Become part of a fast-growing international and diverse team



What you will do:


Translate business problems into structured analytical approaches and data solutions
Analyse structured and unstructured data to identify insights and opportunities
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, datasets, and scalable data-processing solutions

Title: Junior Data Analyst & AI Automation Specialist
Description:
En Rubió llevamos más de 55 años trabajando para que todas las personas tengan acceso a nuestros medicamentos, independientemente de la prevalencia de su patología, contribuyendo así a mejorar su calidad de vida.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst & Automation Specialist para Nutribrain, una compañía especializada en la fabricación y comercialización de suplementos alimenticios naturales, orientados al bienestar mental y físico, la nutrición y la mejora de la calidad de vida, con una fuerte apuesta por la innovación, la investigación y la calidad en el ámbito de la salud.




La posición estará ubicada en Barcelona y se integrará en un equipo pequeño y ágil, donde los datos tienen un papel clave en la toma de decisiones. La persona seleccionada trabajará directamente con el CEO, con autonomía y margen para proponer y desarrollar soluciones.




¿Cuál será tu rol?




La persona seleccionada tendrá un rol dinámico y transversal, combinando análisis de datos, desarrollo de herramientas y automatización de procesos.




Será responsable de transformar datos en información útil para el negocio y de desarrollar soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y automatizar procesos, trabajando con datos de ventas, previsiones, stock y diferentes plataformas y marketplaces.




Además del análisis técnico, la persona será capaz de interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio, entendiendo el impacto de variables como ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, stock, rotación de producto y previsiones, para aportar recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.




Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a diferentes áreas del negocio, participando en el desarrollo de soluciones y herramientas propias.




Funciones principales




Análisis de datos y automatización

Analizar datos de negocio, incluyendo ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales, identificando tendencias, estacionalidades e inconsistencias.
Desarrollar dashboards y herramientas de visualización que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y desarrollar automatizaciones e integraciones entre plataformas, APIs y bases de datos.
Crear flujos de datos automatizados y herramientas propias para obtener información de fuentes sin API oficial, mediante web scraping y automatización de navegadores.
Desarrollar aplicaciones y soluciones internas adaptadas a las necesidades del negocio.
Interpretar indicadores de negocio relacionados con ventas, rentabilidad, stock y catálogo de producto, identificando oportunidades de mejora y apoyando la toma de decisiones desde una perspectiva financiera y comercial.




IA y desarrollo de nuevas soluciones

Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a procesos y necesidades reales del negocio.
Integrar modelos de lenguaje y herramientas de IA en flujos de trabajo y automatizaciones.
Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones de IA audiovisual para generación de vídeo, voz e imagen.
Identificar nuevas oportunidades de automatización y proponer soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y aportar valor al negocio.




¿Qué requisitos buscamos?




Formación y experiencia: 2-4 años de experiencia en análisis de datos aplicado a negocio, con capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos y entornos dinámicos.
Análisis de datos: sólida capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico, con experiencia en análisis de ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales.
Programación y datos: buen dominio de SQL y Python (pandas), experiencia con datasets reales, Git/GitHub y APIs REST.
Automatización: experiencia con web scraping, automatización de navegadores y herramientas de integración y automatización de procesos.
Herramientas y tecnología: nivel avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y, valorable, experiencia con herramientas de BI, bases de datos, n8n, Make, Zapier o tecnologías similares.
IA y nuevas tecnologías: Dominio de asistentes de programación y desarrollo basados en IA, como Codex, Claude Code, Cursor o herramientas similares, utilizándolos de forma habitual para acelerar el desarrollo y la automatización, curiosidad por mantenerse al día de la evolución de los modelos de IA, nuevas capacidades y herramientas emergentes, evaluando su aplicación práctica en el entorno empresarial.
Perfil personal: persona resolutiva, autónoma, organizada y con capacidad para gestionar proyectos propios y encontrar soluciones ante nuevos retos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación estable.
Presencial de lunes, miércoles y jueves en oficinas de Barcelona.
Martes y viernes con posibilidad de teletrabajo.
Viernes con jornada intensiva.
Incorporación a un equipo en crecimiento con oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional.




Si crees que encajas con el perfil y quieres formar parte de un equipo comprometido con la innovación y la excelencia, ¡te estamos buscando!




Si quieres saber más sobre nosotros, visita nuestra web:




www.laboratoriosrubio.com

https://www.nutribrain.eu/
