Title: Data Analyst II Rider Experience
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR WORK-LIFE OPPORTUNITY:

Join our team and become an integral part of Glovo's Global Logistics! We provide a dynamic and challenging environment filled with numerous opportunities for growth and development.

In this role, you will be responsible for redesigning, testing, and implementing the payment structures that motivate and reward our riders worldwide. By blending deep data analysis and data modeling with creative problem-solving, your work will ensure our logistics network is efficient, scalable, and fair for our riders. The KPIs you will influence are crucial to operations, as every decision made will directly affect the whole operational investment (biggest company cost).

Be a Part Of a Team Where You Will


Explore and find the most optimal logistics payment structure in order to maximize global riders engagement.
Strategically redesign our courier payment framework to improve key operational metrics, designing models that reward factors like vehicle used, distance, weight, and peak-hour availability.
Dive deep into massive datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Your insights will be the foundation for optimizing our entire operational investment.
Own the experimentation process to validate your ideas. You will design, run, and analyze experiments (A/B testing, switchback tests) to precisely measure the impact of payment structure changes before a global rollout.
Continuously monitor the performance of your strategies. You will track KPIs, assess the effectiveness of your changes, and make data-driven adjustments as needed.
Understand and address local and regional needs by stepping into the shoes of the riders and truly understanding their perspective.


Qualifications

YOU HAVE


Degree in Engineering, Maths or another STEM field.
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role where you translated insights into tangible business actions and measured their impact.
Strong technical proficiency
Advanced SQL for complex querying and data extraction.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and data orchestration.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.
Nice to have experience with experimentation. Designing and/or analyzing A/B tests or other statistical testing methodologies to measure impact.
Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.
You can clearly and concisely explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English is a must.
You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Additional Information

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.


At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

Title: REVENUE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS ANALYST
Description:
LEVEL is a long-haul airline based in Barcelona and part of the IAG group. The company is customer-centric and places a strong emphasis on values such as commitment, an open attitude, a constant drive for improvement, and making travel easy for their customers. With a focus on providing an exceptional customer experience, LEVEL is committed to delivering top-notch service and exceeding the expectations of their passengers

Job Purpose

The RM Systems Specialist supports the Revenue Management team in the day-to-day calibration of the Revenue Management System (RMS), the automation of manual processes, and the development of the KPI framework. This role blends strong data analytics skills with growing expertise in RM systems, enabling the Pricing and Inventory teams to work faster, smarter, and with better data.

The RM Systems Specialist reports to the RM Systems, Processes & KPIs Manager

Main Responsibilities - Tasks2. Process Excellence & Business Automation3. KPI Framework & Performance AuditingEducation


RMS Ownership & Technical Strategy
System Configuration & Calibration: Support the administration and fine-tuning of the Revenue Management Systems (AirRM & PROS), assisting with demand forecasting models, influence factors, and optimizer settings.
Business Rule Management: Support the implementation and validation of RM business rules, ensuring system configurations align with commercial and operational objectives.
Data Integration & Quality Assurance: Validate data flows between the PSS, RMS, and external data sources (e.g., Infare), ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability for Revenue Management processes.
Automation Projects: Design and build automation scripts and tools (SQL, Python, RPA) to eliminate manual, repetitive tasks and free up analyst time for higher-value work.
System Enhancements & Testing: Coordinate and execute functional testing for RM system enhancements, configuration changes, and new releases, ensuring solutions meet business requirements before deployment.
Knowledge Management & Best Practices: Develop and maintain the RM knowledge base, documenting system processes and best practices to ensure consistency and facilitate knowledge sharing across the team.
Dashboard Development: Build and maintain the RM “Health Check” dashboard in Power BI, tracking metrics such as Forecast Accuracy (MAPE), Yield Opportunity Loss, and Spill/Spoilage.
Override Analysis: Support “Post-Mortem” audits on analyst overrides to help measure their value-add versus the system’s baseline.
Data Deep-Dives: Analyze no-show trends, cancellation patterns, and denied boarding data to identify revenue opportunities/leakage points.


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or similar).

Experience

Prior experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or in a similar quantitative role is required; prior experience in Revenue Management, Pricing, or the airline/travel industry is a plus, but not a must

Competencies


System Exposure: Familiarity with RM systems (AirRM, PROS, or similar) and core RM concepts (e.g., EMSRb, Dynamic Pricing) is a plus.


Technical Stack:


SQL: Solid working knowledge (BigQuery, Snowflake, or SQL Server) for data extraction and analysis.
Data Viz: Experience with Power BI or Tableau to build dashboards and automated reports.
Coding: Proficiency in Python or R for automation and predictive modeling is highly valued.
Analytical Mindset: Comfortable investigating why numbers move and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Communication: Able to work closely with both technical teams and commercial stakeholders
Mindset: Analytical, curious, and driven to continuously learn, with a strong interest in developing expertise in RM and supporting data-driven decisions.


Languages


Fluent in English and Spanish


Other

Forecast Accuracy: Contributing to reducing the delta between predicted and actual demand.
Automation Impact: Number and impact of manual processes automated and analyst hours saved.

Data Integrity: Minimizing discrepancies between PSS, RMS, and BI reporting.

Title: Customer Data Analyst
Description:
Description

The Opportunity:

As a Customer Data Analyst within our Professional Services team, you will play a critical role in transforming raw customer data into actionable insights. You will be responsible for collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and interpreting data related to customer engagements, service delivery, product adoption, and overall customer health. Your analysis will directly inform strategic decisions, optimize our service offerings, enhance customer experience, and contribute to the overall success of our customers and the Professional Services organization. You will collaborate closely with Professional Services leadership, consultants, project managers, and customer success managers to understand their data needs and deliver impactful reports and analyses.

Key Responsibilities:


Data Collection and Management:
Identify and gather relevant customer data from various sources, including CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics 365), project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana), customer success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero), support ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow), and other relevant databases.
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through data cleaning, validation, and transformation processes.
Develop and maintain data pipelines and data models to facilitate efficient data retrieval and analysis.
Data Analysis and Interpretation:
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and correlations related to customer behavior, service utilization, project outcomes, and customer satisfaction.
Develop and apply statistical techniques and data visualization methods to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets.
Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to Professional Services, such as project profitability, service delivery efficiency, customer adoption rates, time-to-value, and customer retention.
Identify opportunities for process improvement, service optimization, and enhanced customer engagement based on data analysis.
Reporting and Communication:
Design and generate regular and ad-hoc reports and dashboards that effectively communicate key findings and insights to stakeholders across the Professional Services organization.
Present data-driven recommendations and actionable insights to Professional Services leadership and team members in a clear and concise manner.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and ensure that reports meet their specific needs.
Develop and maintain documentation for data sources, methodologies, and reporting processes.
Collaboration and Support:
Partner with Professional Services leadership to define data-driven strategies and objectives.
Support project teams and consultants with data analysis to inform project planning, execution, and risk mitigation. Work closely with Customer Project Managers to identify at-risk customers and opportunities for proactive engagement based on data insights.
Contribute to the development of data literacy within the Professional Services team.

Job Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
3+ years of experience in a data analysis role, preferably within a Professional Services, SaaS, or technology-focused organization.
Proven ability to collect, clean, analyze, and interpret complex datasets from various sources.
Strong proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python (with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn), and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Heavy.ai).
Experience working with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), customer success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero), and other relevant business applications.
Solid understanding of statistical concepts and methodologies.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills with a keen attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
A strong understanding of Professional Services methodologies and customer lifecycle management is a plus.
Background Check Required


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with data warehousing concepts and technologies.
Familiarity with machine learning techniques and their application to business problems.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using ETL tools.
Certifications in relevant data analysis or business intelligence tools.


About

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. Title: Data & Yield Analyst
Description:
About Softonic

At Softonic, people come first. We’re a multicultural team passionate about building digital experiences used by millions of users worldwide. Guided by a fail fast, learn faster mindset, we encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous improvement, to make a real impact.

Our culture is shaped by four principles:


Step up: Take ownership and act with integrity.
Work smart: Focus on impact and efficiency.
One team: Collaborate openly and support each other.
Think big: Stay curious and challenge the status quo.


Team up with us to grow your career in an international, collaborative, and people-focused company where your ideas matter and your work reaches a global audience.

About The Role

We are a global premium publisher with 28 years of history, providing quality software & APPs download services across multiple languages, also expanding with white labels (Download.com Filehippo), Publisher network (rev.amp), and more partnerships on the way.

As our data & yield analyst reporting to the Director of Advertising, you will be responsible for bridging all revenue team’s data-analytics need (including but not limited to datasets, data visualization, and automation with the process for revenue generation/optimization purposes) with our BI team, to drive initiatives that will boost making more & better data-driven decisions and improve efficiency on revenue generation. Will also take the yield function to analyze market trends & discover business opportunities, not only providing insights to the relevant teams (Sales, Paid, Partnership, Adtech, Product, Traffic, etc) but also following through with the implementation of the initiatives to ensure the business impact is realized.

Key Responsibilities


Be a data champion inside the Advertising & RevOps team and the go-to-person for ithe team & stakeholders from other revenue teams when it comes to better utilization of our data.
Help revenue teams to identify opportunities: using new data points, visualization and automation solutions and ideas to improve revenue generation efficiency, take those requirements, coordinate with dev (BI or other teams) to build the roadmap for the projects & implement accordingly.
Oversee & analyze mid-long (monthly, quarterly, YoY) term yield performance/trends of revenue streams & devices, provide insights on fluctuation, alerts when needed, and recommend a clear plan of action.
Provide A/B test or lean test analysis with recommendations for revenue-related initiatives.
Manage UPR optimisation and automation of pricing recommendation tool (either 3rd party or in-house).
Be able to use agentic AI tools to automate process & streamline data processing & analytic flows to deliver results efficiently
Provide insights on market trends, opportunities, and inventory availability information to the sales & AMs team for better usage of market data
Help teams turn data into actionable insights that unlock revenue opportunities and support smarter business decisions.


Must have


At least 2 years of working experience working as business analyst, preferably with experience in digital advertising business.
Experience of working with BI platforms, like Tableau, Qlikview & advance skills of Google Analytics.
Experience of doing data analysis work with AI tools like Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, etc.
Experience of working with BigQuery, SQL & Python.
Preferable background on big data, data science related topics.
Experience building analytical models and working with structured and unstructured data sets to drive business decisions.
Knowledge of the online advertising ecosystem.
Basic understanding of budgeting, financial forecast, and accounting principles is preferred.
Excellent communication and project management skills with a strong business acumen.
Ability to work on own initiative in a fast-moving environment.
High level of motivation, determination and commitment.
An excellent command of both written and spoken English is required.


Why Softonic?


Private Health Care
Hybrid Work Model (3 days on-site per week in Poblenou area)
Flexible remote work options during certain periods of the year
Flexible Spending Plan & Free Tax Consultant
Learning & Development: Language Classes (English, Spanish, Catalan) and Training Program
Workplace Amenities: Dining Room, Gaming Room, Terraces, and complimentary fresh fruit, coffee, snacks, and drinks
Team & Social Events: Pizza & Beers every Thursday
Lifestyle Benefits: Discounts at gyms and restaurants
Additional Time Off: Birthday leave
Opt for: Mac or Windows laptop
Wellhub program

Job Title

BI Data Acquisition Analyst (Hospitality)

Summary

The BI Data Acquisition Analyst will be instrumental in on-boarding global hospitality industry data to support our Business Intelligence Solutions. This role will perform a diverse set of critical duties related to the implementation and maintenance of processes to acquire and retain quality data assets. Your Main Responsibilities


Facilitate communication between the business and technical teams throughout the data acquisition process.
Analyze and document business requirements to support the data acquisition process.

Recommend enhancements to data acquisition processes and systems of record to improve data accuracy.
Conduct ongoing data analysis and auditing to support timely and accurate delivery to clients.


About The Ideal Candidate


Relevant experience in the hospitality industry and familiarity with hospitality standards and terminology.
Experience with the SQL query language is beneficial.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) workflows is beneficial.
Proven ability to efficiently manage and implement tactical projects.
Understanding of database and data warehouse architecture is beneficial.
Self-starter who works well in a collaborative and dynamic environment.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Title: Data Analyst - People & Product
Description:
Hi! 👋

At Factorial we're on the lookout for a Data Analyst to raise the bar on how we turn data into decisions across the business 🚀.

The Role ✨

At Factorial, data sits at the heart of every decision we make — and we're looking for a Data Analyst to make it count where it matters most: our people.

This is a hybrid role that combines two profiles — the responsibilities of an Analytics Engineer and those of a Data Analyst. As an Analytics Engineer, you model and structure data in the gold layer with DBT, turning raw tables into reliable, documented models a whole business area can trust. As a Data Analyst, you build advanced analysis on top of them, own the metrics they expose, and deliver the reporting the business runs on — carrying out dashboards and ad-hoc deep-dives that turn open questions into decisions, hand in hand with Business.

You'll focus primarily on our People area — our biggest opportunity — bringing a data-driven approach to how we understand, hire, and grow our teams, and shaping high-stakes decisions across talent acquisition, headcount planning, engagement, and performance. You'll also partner with Product, helping define how we iterate the product and turning data into real impact on pricing, packaging, and usage.

Factorial is a fast-paced scale-up in constant evolution — some areas are still building their data foundations while others are already driven by the power of data . You won't inherit a finished playbook; you'll write it, raising the analytical bar as the company grows. If you're driven by curiosity, energized by ambiguity, and want ownership of both the data model and the decisions it drives, this one's for you

What You'll Be Doing


Own the data models: Design, build, and maintain the gold-layer models (DBT) that become the single source of truth for your business area — with the tests and documentation that keep them trusted and reused across teams.
Own metrics and governance: Define and document your area's KPIs, resolve conflicting definitions across teams, and maintain a single source of truth others are expected to use.
Treat dashboards as a product: Build reporting in Power BI with clear ownership, and keep iterating on it based on how it's actually used.
Go beyond dashboards: Run the advanced analysis that answers the "why" — cohort and retention analyses, impact modeling, and scenario / forecasting — and turn findings into concrete product, pricing, or lifecycle recommendations.
Enable decision-making: Partner with Business and Product teams to turn ambiguous questions into the right analysis, and run the work that determines whether a decision actually moved the needle.
Foster business–data collaboration: Embed with your stakeholders, build a shared language around metrics, and strengthen how the business and the Data team work together — so data becomes a habit, not an afterthought.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics Engineers to keep data integrity high, prepare the layer models consume, and translate model outputs into metrics the business understands.
Master data storytelling: Turn analysis into clear narratives that align stakeholders and inspire action — so the work actually changes what people do.


What We're Looking For

You're likely a great fit if you:


Have 3+ years in Analytics Engineering, BI, or Data Analyst roles — ideally in a fast-paced, scaling tech environment.
Write fluent, independent SQL — you can model and debug complex queries on your own, without waiting on review.
Are comfortable with Python for analysis and lightweight data workflows.
Know your way around DBT and a layered / medallion modeling approach (bronze / silver / gold).
Have shipped a BI tool in production, Power BI ideally (or an equivalent like Looker / Tableau).
Have solid advanced-analytics fundamentals: cohort and retention analysis, segmentation, funnel and driver analysis, and experimentation (A/B) backed by a solid statistics background.
Use version control (Git / GitHub) as part of your normal workflow.
Are business-minded and communicate with impact — you understand what stakeholders really need (not just what they ask for), reframe the question, and translate complex data into clear, actionable insight that drives decisions.
Are autonomous, proactive, and detail-oriented — you see ambiguity as an opportunity, not a blocker.
Treat the metrics and models you build as products, not one-off deliverables.
Have English working proficiency.


Bonus Points if You:


Understand subscription or product-based (SaaS) economics and can connect data work to revenue, growth, and retention outcomes.
Have owned a metrics framework that became the reference.
Have partnered closely with Data Science to bring models into production and translate their output into business decisions.
Have helped build or scale an analytics function — tooling, modeling and documentation standards, processes, and KPI frameworks — leaving it more mature than you found it.
Have delivered visible impact in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment, bringing structure to ambiguity and moving decisions forward.
Have a quantitative background (degree or equivalent practical depth) you apply to real business problems.


If you're ready to take on this challenge at Factorial, apply now! We can't wait to see what you'll bring to our team. 🌟

Compensation 💰

The salary range for this position is [42800 - 53500 ]€ total compensation + ESOP plan. We won't consider how many years of experience you have but your knowledge and skills.

We care about people, and we also offer employee benefits.

About Factorial 🚀

At Factorial, we’re building the leading AI Business Management Software for companies of all sizes. Our platform centralizes key workflows across HR, Finance, Talent, Operations, and IT, freeing teams from manual processes so they can focus on what really matters: leading, growing, and taking care of their people.With over 1,500 employees across Europe, Asia, Africa, and America. We are one of Europe’s fastest-growing SaaS companies, proudly headquartered in Barcelona. If you're excited to shape the future of business management technology, we’d love to meet you.

We believe in diverse talent: we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of diverse experiences and identities to apply.

We believe in inclusion: we are committed to equal opportunities and actively promote workplace inclusion of people with disabilities. If you would like to learn more about our inclusive recruitment processes, you are welcome to indicate so optionally and we will share additional information with you.

Our Values


We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.
We learn and teach: We're dedicated to learning something new every day and, above all, share it.
We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other.
We grow fast: We act fast. We think that the worst mistake is not learning from them.


Perks of being part of our team

We care about people and we also offer a lot of benefits for employees:


High growth, multicultural and friendly environment 🤝
Alan as private health insurance 🩺
Healthy life with Wellhub (Gyms, pools, outdoor classes) 🧘🏽‍♀️
Save expenses with Cobee 💰
Language classes 👩🏽‍🏫
Breakfast in the office and organic fruit 🍏
Nora discounts 🍱
Free caffeine and theine ☕
Pet Friendly 🐕

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
¿Quieres formar parte de una consolidada empresa en el sector del Ocio y Entretenimiento donde se trabaja siempre con las últimas tecnologías?




¡CIRSA es tu lugar!




¡Tenemos una posición de Junior Data Analyst para formar parte del Departamento de Tesorería en nuestras oficinas de Terrassa!




¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?




⌚Flexibilidad horaria

📅Política híbrida de teletrabajo

🤝 Bonus referral por referenciar a una persona que cumpla con el perfil que buscamos. ¡Tu recomendación es garantía extra de calidad!

💳 Paquete de retribución flexible con beneficios en tributación (tarjeta restaurante, seguro médico, bono transporte, formación o guardería)

📚 Formación continua con un amplio catálogo de cursos a tu alcance

✅ Programa de Becas CIRSA para formarte en lo que quieras

🌱 Empresa comprometida socialmente a través de la ESG

🧘 Programas de wellbeing: risoterapia, alimentación saludable, yoga...

🚴 Clubes deportivos CIRSA: running club, bike club y pádel club dónde podrás competir en torneos internos y contra otras empresas.




¿Qué harás con nosotros?




Participarás en la gestión y optimización de los datos financieros de las aplicaciones de tesorería del grupo, contribuyendo a garantizar su calidad y fiabilidad.
Colaborarás en la identificación y resolución de incidencias relacionadas con la integridad y consistencia de los datos.
Elaborarás informes y cuadros de mando en Power BI, transformando los datos en información útil para la toma de decisiones.
Darás soporte en proyectos de gestión de datos y mejora de procesos dentro del área de Tesorería.
Colaborarás con los equipos locales para facilitar el uso de las herramientas y procesos financieros.
Trabajarás de forma transversal con diferentes departamentos para mejorar la calidad de la información y la eficiencia operativa.
Participarás en iniciativas de automatización y optimización continua, contribuyendo a la mejora de los procesos del área.




¿Qué te hará triunfar en la posición?




Contar con una formación técnica, preferiblemente un CFGS en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma o similar, que te aporte una base sólida en programación y tecnologías de la información.
Que aportes un mínimo de 2 años de experiencia trabajando con datos, realizando análisis, explotación de información y generación de reportes para dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.
Disfrutar trabajando con datos, siendo capaz de analizar, gestionar y garantizar la calidad de grandes volúmenes de información.
Tener conocimientos o interés en desarrollarte en tecnologías como Python, .NET, Power Automate, macros y scripting, contribuyendo a la automatización y mejora de procesos.
Manejar con soltura herramientas como Excel, Office 365 y Power BI para el análisis, tratamiento y visualización de datos.
Destacar por tu capacidad de organización, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
Tener buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo, colaborando eficazmente con diferentes áreas de la compañía.
Mostrar una actitud proactiva, curiosidad por la tecnología y ganas de aprender y afrontar nuevos retos.







Si eres una persona apasionada de tu trabajo y quieres seguir desarrollando tu carrera profesional ¡Inscríbete!




CIRSA es una compañía implicada con la Igualdad de Oportunidades. Por ello, nos responsabilizamos para que nuestros procesos de selección se lleven a cabo en igualdad de condiciones y sin discriminaciones por razón de nacimiento, edad, raza, sexo, orientación sexual, religión, estatus marital, opinión o cualquier otra condición física, personal o social protegida por las leyes.

Si quieres desarrollar tus capacidades en un entorno internacional, apostando por trabajar en soluciones de I+D tanto en Ingeniería como en IT, ¡este es tu próximo destino!

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards avanzados en Power BI, asegurando altos estándares de calidad, rendimiento y usabilidad.
Analizar y resolver incidencias en los dashboards existentes, garantizando su estabilidad y fiabilidad.
Realizar el modelado de datos, optimizando estructuras y flujos de información.
Desarrollar y optimizar consultas SQL para la extracción, transformación y análisis de datos.
Colaborar en un entorno internacional, utilizando inglés oral de forma habitual en el día a día.

Tendrás contrato indefinido y horario flexible
Podrás trabajar en modelo híbrido. Trabajarás 3 días a la semana en la oficina de Sant Cugat del Vallès. El resto de días puedes teletrabajar.
Tendrás un PC y los periféricos necesarios para el desarrollo de tu trabajo.
Trabajarás en un entorno internacional.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
Life is too short to work for a boring company, so why don’t you join us? We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our dynamic team. This position works in concert with the Project Manager on determining product usability, requirements and prioritization. Your main mission will be to define and execute analyses of our users and companies with the objective of identifying trends, opportunities, and problems to improve the product.

The ideal candidate will have interest in the eCommerce world, possess good communication and great analytical skills. Overall, the individual will be an active part of an organization focused on innovative business architecture design, operational execution, and channel integration.

Does that sound like you?

But first, let’s break the ice!

Who We Are And What We Do

Since 2009, we have been fostering innovative and creative techniques across many industries, making us pioneers in online project management.

Leadtech is dedicated to constant improvement and inspiring new ideas daily for the world we live in and the future to come.

If you have a creative and innovative mind, Leadtech is looking for you!

Does this still look like your cup of tea? There’s more

Responsibilities

You’re our perfect candidate if you:


Worked on software B2C platforms that scale and grow and been within the Product team
Monitor on a daily basis KPI’s and understand the product and business performance.
Explore data to find actionable insights and make product recommendations through funnels, cohort analyses, long-term trends, user segmentation, regression models, predictive analytics, and more.
Define and execute recurring and ad hoc performance reports, this includes calculations of LTV, marketing performance, retention, ROI, user behavior, and unit economics
Analyse performance impact of any product and marketing strategy changes.
Work in coordination with the BI, infrastructure, and data engineering team to optimise the reporting tools, data accuracy, and overall reporting.
Recommend and analyze multivariate experiments.


Required Skills

Your expertise in a nutshell:


At least two years experience in data analysis and reporting, business data management, data collection, report design and presentation.
Knowledge of analytics platforms and ability to utilize the data/tools to guide decision making.
Familiarity with Python and SQL, and tools such as Databricks, Tableau and Amplitude
Exceptional analytical skills and data-driven mindset.
Experience running A/B tests
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Problem solver and results-driven, with a can-do attitude.
Ability to collaborate with engineering, product, and marketing to understand their world and deliver impactful insights against these
Experience in the B2C world is a nice-to-have.
Advanced level in English


Interested? Keep on reading!

Benefits

WHY LEADTECH


Diversified app portfolio with millions of active users in a high-growth non-gaming vertical.
Mature data infrastructure: BigQuery, Looker, AppsFlyer, and a proprietary analytics stack for fast decision-making.
Experimentation culture: real autonomy to propose and ship changes in production.
International team, dynamic environment, and the opportunity for direct P&L impact.
Competitive compensation package + benefits (flexible hours, health insurance, training).


Growth and career development


At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities.


Work-Life balance

Title: Data Analytics Consultant
Description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Lisbon Office where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 200 people. Consultants based in Lisbon will support clients globally with the opportunity for international travel. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

This role sits within Efficio's Digital Delivery team, working at the intersection of consulting, data and technology.

Rather than building dashboards or maintaining internal reporting, you'll use data to solve real procurement and supply chain challenges for global clients.

You'll work alongside our consulting teams to understand client data, assess its quality, build analytical datasets such as Spend Cubes, and deliver insights that directly influence sourcing decisions and business outcomes.

Every project is different. One week you might be analysing ERP data for a global manufacturer, while the next you're helping consultants understand supplier spend patterns or using Python to automate data preparation for a new client engagement.

This is a hands-on delivery role combining technical problem-solving, analytical thinking and client collaboration.

What You’ll Be Doing


Work alongside consulting teams on global procurement and supply chain transformation projects.
Gather, assess and understand client data from ERP systems and other sources.
Clean, transform and structure complex datasets into analytical models such as Spend Cubes.
Develop data pipelines and automate repetitive data preparation activities using Python, SQL and AI.
Analyse procurement and spend data to uncover sourcing opportunities and support consulting recommendations.
Use AI-enabled tools and internal technologies to improve delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into data solutions.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve delivery processes through knowledge sharing and automation.


What we are looking for:


At least 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data consulting, or a related field.
Experience working with SQL.
Experience using Python for data manipulation or automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with and processing varied, disparate datasets.
Familiarity with Excel and data visualisation tools. We are using Sigma, but experience in PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik or similar will be valued).
Curious and eager to understand how businesses operate.
Comfortable working in across multiple projects.
Strong communication skills.


Nice to have:


Experience working with ERP data (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)
Procurement or supply chain exposure
Experience with AI-assisted analytics or automation
Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Run python-based analytical engines on a regular basis;
Collect data (internal & external) and investigate their business value through data analysis and visualization;
Create and adapt data analysis models and tools;
Mount, execute and automate ETL processes for extracting data (with python and SQL) to serve analytical needs;

Title: Data Services Analyst
Description:
What Makes Us Unique


At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024 – but we're just getting started. 


How You'll Make an Impact:



We are seeking a dynamic Data Import & Reporting Analyst to join our customer success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence.

Your mission is two-fold: first, you will orchestrate smooth data migrations, helping new clients transition their historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) from legacy systems to Cloudbeds. Second, you will act as a reporting strategist, coaching clients on how to leverage Cloudbeds’ reporting features to extract meaningful insights, track KPIs, and drive data-backed business decisions from day one.


Our Data Services Team:



We are a collaborative, remote-first team energised by solving complex data puzzles and transforming technical transitions into seamless, empowering experiences for hoteliers worldwide. We thrive on cross-functional teamwork, blending analytical precision with a passion for client education so that no property is left in the dark. If you love deep-diving into spreadsheets just as much as celebrating a client’s "aha!" moment when their data reporting clicks, these are your people.


What You Bring to the Team:



Lead Data Migrations: Act as the primary technical advisor guiding new clients through the smooth transition of historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) into Cloudbeds.
Execute Data Manipulation: Extract, clean, map, and validate client data from CSV/Excel formats to ensure flawless system uploads.
Drive Technical Troubleshooting: Proactively identify and resolve formatting discrepancies or system mismatches before clients go live.
Empower Clients Through Coaching: Train properties on how to build, customize, and automate operational and financial reports within the Cloudbeds platform.
Ensure Data Integrity: Guide clients through post-migration audits to validate accuracy across financial histories and occupancy metrics.
Advise on Best Practices: Consult with property managers on key performance indicators (KPIs) to help optimize their daily operations from day one.


What Sets You Up for Success:



Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems (e.g., Cloudbeds, Opera, Mews, Protel, or similar software).
Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users.
Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning).
Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records.
Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions.
Multilingual Capabilities: Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in both Portuguese and Spanish


Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional):



BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us


Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Title: Data Intelligence and Automation Specialist
Description:
Verisure is seeking a passionate Data Intelligence and Automation Specialist with colleagues across Europe. The role will report to Operational Excellence & SSC Implementation Manager and will be based in Lisbon.

The Data Intelligence and Automation Specialist is responsible for providing data-driven insights and automation solutions. This is an exciting new role, you’ll work with powerful tools such as Snowflake, Python, SQL, and Streamlit that will play a key part in building a world-class data intelligence and automation function, working closely with senior professionals across our European operations.

The company’s success depends on its people, and it invests in them every day. Working with Verisure is being part of an industry leading world-class company that has a strong entrepreneurial spirit. 

Responsibilities


Deliver precise and actionable insights from data and reports to various business units, enabling them to make informed decisions.
Design and develop dynamic dashboards that serve as the foundation for management's strategic and tactical decisions.
Conduct deep analyses that shape policy decisions, optimizing our service and product experiences.
Extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources to create comprehensive end-user reports.
Collaborate with key stakeholders to enhance our data warehouse, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of the business.
Manage data governance and master data, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and security across the organization.
Create and implement tools based on business requirements, streamlining processes and boosting efficiency through automation.


Experience And Qualifications

We are looking for a self-driven individual who will excel in transforming raw data into valuable insights, developing innovative tools, and implementing advanced analytics.


A minimum of 3 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, and data science.
Fluent in English with strong communication skills.


To succeed in the role, we believe you have some of the following experience:


Expertise in SQL and business intelligence reporting tools.
Proficiency with ETL and data modeling tools.
Skills in Power BI or similar tools.
Scripting skills in PHP, Python or VBA.
Experience in designing and deploying RPA solutions using Python.


Are you interested in becoming a part of Verisure? Apply today!

If you are interested, please apply through our application system. Due to GDPR reasons and to ensure a fair process for everyone we do not accept applications through email. 

If you have questions regarding this position reach out to our Global TA Lead, Charlotta Rydström, charlotta.rydstrom@verisure.com.    

About us: 

Verisure is the leading European provider of professionally monitored security systems with 24/7 response services. We protect more than 5.1 million families and small businesses across 17 countries in Europe and Latin America. Under our Arlo brand, we are also a leading provider of cameras and video-surveillance services in Europe. Our mission is to provide our customers with peace of mind by protecting what matters most to them. 

At Verisure, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognizing that diversity of thought and background only makes our teams stronger and more innovative. We reject all forms of discrimination and bias, and we believe in access to opportunities for everyone, regardless of gender, age, disability status, race, sexual orientation, or any other status.

Experiência Profissional

Formação Académica

Idiomas

Soft Skills

Title: Data Analytics Officer
Description:
About The Job


The Stress Testing Data Analytics (STDA) team belongs to the Produce Pillar of Models and Simulations for You (MS4U) department. The MS4U department focuses on several key missions: developing models (pillar 1 and pillar 2), conducting backtestings and simulation activities, producing regulatory stress testing exercises (European Banking Authority, European Central Bank), supporting Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP) and budget exercises, generating IFRS9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) reports, preparing regulatory reporting, such as climate risk, Non-Performing Loan (NPL), and benchmarking Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA)/IFRS9, and performing local stress tests
The STDA team consists of data engineers and project managers working within the scope of credit risk and securitisation. STDA collects, analyses, reconciles, and builds databases to ensure the success of these exercises
The team works in a Big Data environment. Dataiku V14 streamlines collaborative development (in SQL, Pyspark) by allowing multiple team members to design, test, and deploy data workflows, while Power BI enables sharing actionable insights across departments
The team works in partnership with the IT department on the platform. They support the team on a daily-basis and help with back-end big data engineering support and maintenance
In this role, you will join the team dedicated to credit risk. Your primary responsibility will be to handle big data, perform data quality assessments, analyse risk parameters across multiple dimensions, report relevant insights based on data analysis, and prepare the databases used for the projection of credit risk parameters


Your Main Activities Are


Perform data collection and build/maintain reliable data transformation pipelines
Work on data ingestion, data quality, data preparation, data cleaning, and data analysis
Automate, optimise, and document the data preparation processes
Develop dynamic Dashboards to report on the most relevant and frequent business topics
Work closely with data providers and clients to get technical and business requirements
Specific contributions to regulatory and internal stress testing exercises


Profile and Skills to Success


Master’s Degree in Information Technology and Computer Science or related
Up to 2 years of experience in Data Analysis / Engineering / Visualisation or similar
Advanced level of English, both written and oral
Knowledge in data exploration and data preparation, SQL, Python, and Risk Management
Attention to detail / rigour
Ability to work with tight deadlines and multidisciplinary teams
Ability to collaborate / teamwork
Communication skills, both written and oral
Organisational skills


About The Team


The team named MS4U, which is a cross-functional platform, designed to provide integrated, end-to-end modelling and simulations capability. It unites RISK M&R (Models and Regulatory), STFS (Stress Testing and Financial Simulations), quantitative teams from RISK CPBS, RISK ESG (modelling), and other modelling competence centres, creating a shared, coherent, Group-wide modelling ecosystem
By joining MS4U team, you will be part of a dynamic, talented and expert team with an international reach


Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner


Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.


Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To


Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.


To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.


Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered.
In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Academic background in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Management, Business Intelligence, Business, Economics, Mathematics

Title: Data Analytics Officer
Description:
About The Job


As a core member of our Data Intelligence team, you’ll transform raw data into reliable, actionable datasets that respond to the need of your clients. Your work will directly enhance reporting accuracy, streamline processes, and solve critical data challenges


Your Main Activities Are


You will produce accurate and coherent datasets for use by other RISK reporting teams
You will need to interpret data models to deliver the correct data to your clients
You define, develop and execute queries and extraction processes
You will present on an ad hoc base basis your data analysis to a larger audience
You contribute to data quality improvement initiatives on behalf of the RISK data perimeter
You automate recurrent data extractions and/or recurrent reports
Can you connect the dots between data and credit risk? You don’t just work with numbers, you understand how data drives credit risk analysis, turning raw information into meaningful insights
Are you fluent in the language of data models? You effortlessly interpret complex (relational) data structures, spotting relationships and uncovering hidden patterns that others might miss
Can you trace data like a detective? You dig into the physical implementation of data models, mapping how information flows and links across systems, no mystery is too complex for you
Do you grasp the full life cycle of credit? From origination to maturity (and everything in between), you know how credits are assigned, managed, and evolved—giving you the context to ask the right questions
Ready to challenge the status quo? Your deep knowledge of the credit life cycle lets you proactively question risk data, ensuring accuracy
Do you speak the language of data and tools? You’re at home in the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Access) and bring hands-on experience with SAP Business Objects (or equivalent) and Microsoft SQL Server (or equivalent). Plus, you process data like a pro—whether in SAS, Python, or database management tools—to deliver results that matter
If this sounds like your skill set, let’s make an impact together


Profile and Skills to Success


Bachelor Degree in Information Technology and Computer Science or related
Up to 2 years of experience in Data Analytics / Information Technology or similar
Advanced level of English, both written and oral
Knowledge in Python, SQL and Tableau
Ability to deliver / results driven
Ability to collaborate / teamwork
Ability to develop and adapt a process
Analytical ability
